notes.title: Patch 1.7.0 - Dreamland: Slumbering Spells
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/09901ac2fc790d556ff37dd0e7ab7fbb4988f627.png"][/img][/p][h3]Welcome to Dreamland: Slumbering Spells, an expansion of our mystical Dreamland update! [url="https://emojipedia.org/mage"]🧙[/url][url="https://emojipedia.org/sparkles"]✨[/url][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/7dbbbaffcfcafc82484cc2ab587b48ac28aef4b8.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Introducing [b]Sorcerer's Spire[/b], the location where it all began: the birth spot of the witches and their fantastical lands! Explore a twisting map full of mystery and magic, and collect over 80 new Dreamland props throughout the map! We've also introduced 50+ new structures to Creative Mode, 40 new Dreamland skins, and the return of the Dreamland event with a brand new exclusive player icon. [url="https://emojipedia.org/crescent-moon"]🌙[/url][/p][p][/p][h3]In even bigger news, we're also launching our new standalone prop fighting game: Prop Sumo! [url="https://emojipedia.org/collision"]💥[/url][/h3][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ygk4a9QB7sw"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][b]Read on to find out more about what we've been working on! [/b][url="https://emojipedia.org/right-arrow-curving-down"]⤵️[/url][/p][p][/p][h1]Sorcerer's Spire![/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/c02b2d1e0dadf3b1b0102f1e8bbd99987a51a8e4.png"][/img][/p][p]Sorcerer's Spire is a mystical new map set in a spectacular observatory. It's what happens when you mix the fantastical world of Dream Valley Castle with the chaos of Twisted House! [url="https://emojipedia.org/dizzy"]💫[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Explore the observatory - a once serene place now unleashed with magical chaos! Hunt and hide amongst the sorcerer's tools and tomes, or take flight on one of the flying books circling the central orrery! [url="https://emojipedia.org/open-book"]📖[/url][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/584c5ba8365a0e8778a282ce50af843c52607efc.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/8b353b27533abb92d26fef8d5ad2fee4287aaa9b.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/62af83b480805495e3ec92f764dccad1e16933d4.png"][/img][/p][p]Drop down the centre of the spire to find a huge spiral staircase, and if you're brave enough - enter the portal at the bottom to see where it takes you! 🌀[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/ac7b588edcdb7865cccaf2689ef42c2b4e1d5570.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/e55cad967758718456bdf8925879398aa586e31e.png"][/img][/p][p]As you head down the spiral staircase, you'll encounter different floors featuring familiar themes and areas from the Witch It universe. What secrets do these locations hold? 🔎[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/2ee19a99e21fa39ca949a5e885bb4f00fe76e268.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/0019d5446b38bb34437df11ae04201a5924f0a72.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/839f31fec40861e2da780d5eb3c4b27abba9d6d0.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/5dfe974b1393bc136273f9307c22a26e185c963f.png"][/img][/p][h1]80+ New Props![/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/c02b2d1e0dadf3b1b0102f1e8bbd99987a51a8e4.png"][/img][/p][p]Blend in with the Sorcerer's Spire by transforming into 80+ new props placed throughout the map! Collect a variety of different vials, jars, stargazing tools, ingredients, furnishings and much, much more. We've even thrown in a ton of secret props to add to your prop collection! 🧪[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/ec5055d1fc30f4299443dd7297bc8aad0c589d7b.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/e91690479a45078e1d7e7050cf762b5f101d8d1f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]50+ New Structures![/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/c02b2d1e0dadf3b1b0102f1e8bbd99987a51a8e4.png"][/img][/p][p]Transform your map designs with over 50 new structures, including all-new windows, pillars, foliage, banners, and even the long-requested addition of pipes! Piece together your own pipe network and finally build that Steampunk map you always wanted to create! 🔩[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/68182021dd102913a2b0ae7419d2b3e6ac463a5a.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]40 New Skins![/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/c02b2d1e0dadf3b1b0102f1e8bbd99987a51a8e4.png"][/img][/p][p]Ascend to another dimension with these otherworldly hunter and witch sets:[/p][p]⭐ [b]Nocturnal Starseeker[/b][/p][p]🪐 [b]Astral Cosmic Oracle[/b][/p][p]⭐ [b]Crepuscular Starseeker[/b][/p][p]🪐 [b]Clairvoyant Cosmic Oracle[/b] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/207b0d9a04e069a21f305acdf17d8ddeaabe20c5.png"][/img][/p][p]Or perhaps it's all just a dream? Cosy up in these snugly sets:[/p][p]💤 [b]Dreamy Sleepwalker[/b][/p][p]🧼 [b]Relaxed Lounger[/b][/p][p]💤 [b]Snuggly Sleepwalker[/b][/p][p]🧼 [b]Languid Lounger[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/74154ddedb41ca37a64a60d30d73685a76d66e9d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]Exclusive Icon![/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/c02b2d1e0dadf3b1b0102f1e8bbd99987a51a8e4.png"][/img][/p][p]Collect the limited time [b]"Sorcerer's Spire"[/b] icon by playing Witch It during the event season. At the end of the Dreamland event, this icon will never return, so make sure to pick it up before it disappears! ⌛[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/9a7ac922c200c7cc55eb46f42aa41d1fa871ecaa.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]New Material Variants![/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/c02b2d1e0dadf3b1b0102f1e8bbd99987a51a8e4.png"][/img][/p][p]Looking to give your map an out-of-this-world vibe? New carpet and wallpaper variants have just landed in Creative Mode! 🧵[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/e083ab117dd9ac861dbc5a43c8c9a3bdf36f6d6a.png"][/img][/p][h1]Prop Sumo + Free Skin![/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/c02b2d1e0dadf3b1b0102f1e8bbd99987a51a8e4.png"][/img][/p][p]We're extremely proud to announce our new game, Prop Sumo, which pits the props you know and love from Witch It in chaotic battles! :rollingbarrel:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/a366bdde7b353ef8fc1e9ce79bc43cc8322de0ef.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Prop Sumo is a side project we've been working on since the start of the year, and is made for peer-to-peer battles between friends. Prop Sumo arrives later this year with the "Friend Pass", which allows all members in your party to play for free [i](without progression)[/i] as long as the host owns the full game! ✔️ [/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3089420/Prop_Sumo/" style="button" buttoncolor="#173d69"]Prop Sumo Store Page[/url][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3089420/Prop_Sumo/"]Sign up for the playtest on the store page today. [/url]We'll be giving access to players over the upcoming weeks so you can try the game before it launches![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Wishlist and follow Prop Sumo to receive the limited-time "Sumo" set in Witch It! 🥋[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/be64e27633e6eb69ec27f3e089a8d23a42698b7c.jpg"][/img][/p][p]You can join the Prop Sumo Discord here:[/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/qfUHmBbwCK" style="button" buttoncolor="#1a406b"]Prop Sumo Discord Server[/url][/p][p][/p][h1]Patch Notes:[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/c02b2d1e0dadf3b1b0102f1e8bbd99987a51a8e4.png"][/img][/p][p]+ Added: New map 'Sorcerer’s Spire'[/p][p]+ Added: 80+ new props[/p][p]+ Added: 50+ new structures to Creative Mode[/p][p]+ Added: 40+ new Skinitems[/p][p]+ Added: New material variants to carpets and wallpaper wall[/p][p]+ Added: User generated maps can now be reported by players in a match
[/p][p]↻ Changed: Playername in the HUD are now smaller and only show up when you look at them[/p][p]↻ Changed: Players don’t lose air control anymore when falling too fast, it is now only lost if they fly or get launched through the air too fast 
[/p][p]✓ Fixed: Random skin selection not saving skin set[/p][p]✓ Fixed: Not being able to select team with a controller in Fill-A-Pot[/p][p]✓ Fixed: Broken spots on multiple maps[/p][p]
[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.6.3 New Castle Catastrophe Maps!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/4110433eb88cb8cd26e367aca9741e8f21b9a6b4.png[/img]
Back in November, we launched [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/559650/view/6538758188053823544?l=english]Castle Catastrophe[/url], Witch It's 4th map contest! Following the release of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/559650/view/4612336377166481899?l=english]200+ new creative mode structures and material overrides[/url], participants now had more creative options than ever while building their contest entries. 🏰

[b]"Castle Catastrophe"[/b] was the contest theme - participants were tasked with creating a castle-themed map that has been struck by a disaster. Map creators had the freedom to interpret this theme however they like, while remaining true to it's core intent. As a result, we had received arguably our most unique, diverse, and incredible selection of entries we've ever had the privilege of judging! 🤯

Each winning map is now [b]implemented into Witch It[/b] and playable on the official Servers.

[h1]Castle Catastrophe Winner Maps![/h1]

[h2][b] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3407925118]Spellbound Town[/url][/b][/h2]
[h3]Created by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/PinoueBanana/myworkshopfiles/?appid=559650]Pinoue Banana[/url][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/3d533539a0d56e8fd6cca54eb79009a8bc11c817.png[/img]

[h2][b] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3400153308]Ingeborg's Wandering Retreat[/url][/b][/h2]
[h3]Created by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198332743267/myworkshopfiles/?appid=559650]Obscura[/url][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/c1aa2c702988d8b4e34853548faf5c0d673b344e.png[/img]

[h2][b] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3401484795]Otsiro Crest Castle[/url][/b][/h2]
[h3]Created by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/friz0/myworkshopfiles/?appid=559650]fri.[/url][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/8dd004066bf6f29ef4c35bce1b3a17d3898eb7d6.png[/img]

[h2][b] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3408791954]Woodcastle Cat-astrophe[/url][/b][/h2]
[h3]Created by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198138924346/myworkshopfiles/?appid=559650]Anghely[/url][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/5a76e3af266ae29b0c67fec94ab5c56bf03be1f1.png[/img]

🌐We also added a New Utility Prop in Creative Mode called [b]World Properties[/b] which allows you the configuration of light, fog and even the Music [i](only available on empty template maps)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/75e5d86b6e5697107c74c95ef990a7021bdb8348.png[/img]
[previewyoutube=-dxhiDaRGHQ;full][/previewyoutube]
And ofcourse a small little tease with [b]3 new Creative Mode structures[/b] honoring the map contest winners & the additional awards winners.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/942478362b56541d02778501bbbbc05ddec67162.png[/img]

✉️There is also a new [b]Feedback Button[/b] in the main menu that sends you to a Feedback form direct in the game.[i](useful for console players)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/3ee8915f5c003e27177da8dd25d889bacf0e9f81.png[/img]

Have fun playin! and enjoy the new Creative Options.


[h1]Patch Notes:[/h1]

notes.title: Castle Catastrophe | Official Map Contest 2024 Results!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/9c3ddcbac554239756ec6f4c586e6e01a59935b7.jpg[/img]
Back in November, we launched [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/559650/view/6538758188053823544?l=english]Castle Catastrophe[/url], Witch It's 4th map contest! Following the release of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/559650/view/4612336377166481899?l=english]200+ new creative mode structures and material overrides[/url], participants now had more creative options than ever while building their contest entries. 🏰

[b]"Castle Catastrophe"[/b] was the contest theme - participants were tasked with creating a castle-themed map that has been struck by a disaster. Map creators had the freedom to interpret this theme however they like, while remaining true to it's core intent. As a result, we had received arguably our most unique, diverse, and incredible selection of entries we've ever had the privilege of judging! 🤯

Each winning map will be [b]implemented into Witch It in our next content update[/b] in the following weeks. Each winner will shortly receive the Grand Architect's Helmet, a Witch It Steam Key, two DLC sets of their choice, their name added to the description of a Creative Mode structure (revealed soon), and the outstanding "Grand Architect" title within our community! 🌟

We decided these winners based on a range of different factors. For us, it was important each winning map was visually pleasing and unique from other entries, but a primary factor for us was ensuring each map was suitable to be played on for potentially thousands upon thousands of rounds! Map size was a paramount factor in judging, and while many entrants made beautiful maps, only a select few creators really got the balance between aesthetics and gameplay just right. In addition, we had introduced a rule that meant an individual person could not take multiple winning spots in Castle Catastrophe - which we felt gave new creators an opportunity to shine through... and that they did! 🏆

[h1]Castle Catastrophe Winners![/h1]
[i]In no particular order...[/i]

[h2][b]🥇 [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3407925118]Spellbound Town[/url][/b][/h2]
[h3]Created by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/PinoueBanana/myworkshopfiles/?appid=559650]Pinoue Banana[/url][/h3]
[i]"You need to cut the tree"[/i] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3407925118][Full Story][/url]

Spellbound Town is Pinoue Banana's first ever map contest entry, as well as their first ever published map on the Witch It workshop - but don't let that fool you! The map is undeniably impressive, featuring a beautiful town transformed by the evil tree at it's centre. Explore and hide within a mix of decorated interiors and vast open areas, but beware of the mysterious corruption slowly reclaiming the town brick by brick... 😈

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/643815c0ea1e051412eb5842dfe3a754486e5fb0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/3d533539a0d56e8fd6cca54eb79009a8bc11c817.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/74a7d4d959c7268a670ba35256493056c87a0cb8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/2e1082f3fe75d6cdf26816a3315c6a8c75359a29.png[/img]

[h2][b]🥇 [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3400153308]Ingeborg's Wandering Retreat[/url][/b][/h2]
[h3]Created by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198332743267/myworkshopfiles/?appid=559650]Obscura[/url][/h3]
[i]"The icy north wind came and captured Ingeborgs Wandering Retreat"[/i] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3400153308][Full Story][/url]

Obscura secures her first ever map contest win with Ingeborg's Wandering Retreat - a familiar, yet outstanding map packed full of intricate detail! The map features a huge living castle that has been frozen in place by an enraged witch. Use this opportunity to climb inside the castle, and explore it's vast hallways and elaborate rooms before the hunters catch you - or hide within the surrounding icy landscape! 🥶

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/c1aa2c702988d8b4e34853548faf5c0d673b344e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/c10b1eb495cb260697b4a7d31e54cb37a64f06da.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/6cf42006186daf0c503d46d6759749de637e2b17.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/50488f8598aea67aa194ac80722ce6cabed96713.png[/img]

[h2][b]🥇 [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3401484795]Otsiro Crest Castle[/url][/b][/h2]
[h3]Created by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/friz0/myworkshopfiles/?appid=559650]fri.[/url][/h3]
[i]"Otsiro Crest Castle was built on a mountain peak where a magical witch anomaly is spreading extremely fast."[/i] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3401484795][Full Story][/url]

Otsiro Crest Castle is fri's second winning map following [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2212542868]Niemeyer Legacy[/url]'s memorable win back almost 5 years ago. A mystical witch anomaly has found it's way through the walls of Otsiro, causing devastating roots to tear through it's grand towers and dramatic environment in and around the castle. notes.title: Patch 1.6.2 - Chinese New Year 2025!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/65c2a5be7fb2bddfc02a265e8a93911c73856ae2.png[/img]

新年好! Witch It is celebrating [b]Year of the Snake[/b] with new CNY skins, fireworks, an exclusive icon, as well as 3 special items - read on! 🧧

[h1]2 Year of the Snake Skins![/h1]
Adorn yourself in two [i]ssslithering[/i] new items - the [b]Lucky Snake Head[/b] for hunters, and the [b]Wood Snake Headpiece[/b] for witches! 🐍

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/e5c9f7ba0aaa6ded43a136e81304314cd3e2cddb.jpg[/img]
[h2]How do I obtain Year of the Snake items?[/h2]
Opening Witch It during the Chinese New Year 2025 event will grant you [b]30 "Fireworks"[/b]!
A Firework contains a [b]random[/b] Chinese New Year item (including CNY items from previous years), which can only be opened by combining them with [b]"Gunpowder"[/b]. 💥

To earn Gunpowder, [b]fill up the Item Cauldron with 250 experience points[/b]. You can see the item cauldron fill up at the end of the round, on the level up screen.

Gunpowder has a [b]50% chance[/b] of being earned on any Official server once the item cauldron is filled. If you're lucky enough to earn one, head back to the main menu and press [b]'Chinese New Year'[/b] to combine it with a Firework! 🎆

Every Chinese New Year item earned through Fireworks are [b]tradable and craftable[/b] even after the event is over. If you use up all your FIreworks, you can craft more by combining 5 Gunpowder together!
[i]Note: Gunpowder can only be obtained in Official servers.[/i]

[b]You can also receive the new items through:[/b]
- Random drops from filling up the item cauldron at the end of a round.
- Trading with other players ([url=https://www.discord.gg/witchit]we recommend using our Discord server to find traders[/url]).

[h1]Year of the Snake Player Icon![/h1]
Celebrate the New Year with the limited time [b][color=#b4274a]"Year of the Snake"[/color][/b] player icon! ✨

Play at least [b]one round[/b] of Witch It in an Official server during the Chinese New Year 2025 event to earn the icon, but don't miss out - [b]the icon will never return once the event is over![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/d577f8ecfab076c7b90028d8fdb89adeb169adab.jpg[/img]

Awarded for hgbf's incredible commitment and talent as a community moderator, as well as their exceptional work on [url=https://propviewer.com/]PropViewer[/url] with fri! 🦆

notes.title: Castle Catastrophe | Official Map Contest 2024
notes.content:
[i]Legends speak of castles, once grand, now ravaged by calamity...
From the might of nature, to the grasp of dark magic...
You must tell their stories one last time, before they disappear forever![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/9c3ddcbac554239756ec6f4c586e6e01a59935b7.jpg[/img]
[i]Welcome to Castle Catastrophe, our 4th Official Map Contest![/i]

[h1]🗺️ Theme[/h1]
[b]Castle Catastrophe[/b] - You must build a castle that has been struck by a disaster!

Your map must [b]feature a castle[/b] within your playable area.
Build an interior or exterior, or a mixture of both!
You can design the entire castle, a portion of the castle, or even just a single room or courtyard - it's up to you.

Additionally, your map must [b]feature a catastrophe[/b].
How you interpret this is up to you! Get creative and brainstorm your ideas before starting them.
Is your catastrophe ongoing, or are you building the ruins following the disaster?
Is your catastrophe a natural disaster, or could it be the work of magic?

[h1]🥇 Main Prize | Official Implementation[/h1]
We are implementing [b]multiple winning submissions[/b] into Witch It as [b]Featured Maps[/b], which can be played on both official and custom servers.
While we have no particular number of winners in mind, the winning maps in Castle Catastrophe will be replacing a number of previously featured maps.
All winning maps will receive baked lighting, and will be played for years to come. Many of our previous Featured Maps have now been [b]played way over 10,000 times[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/84748763c2dfffb2a0bec67b3d6026416ea754b6.jpg[/img]
[b]Each contributor in a winning map will also receive:[/b]
🔹 The Grand Architect's Helmet for the Hunter.
🔹 1x Witch It Steam Key (giftable)
🔹 Two DLC sets of their choice!
🔹 Your name added to the description of a Creative Mode structure!
🔹 Grand Architect Discord role!

[h1]🏆 Additional Awards[/h1]
We are offering additional awards for 3 different categories.

🖼️ [b]Presentation Award: Awarded to the entry with the best presentation.[/b]
To win this award, spend time making your workshop page visually appealing, through screenshots, banners, a video (if you like), or anything else to make it stand out from the other entries!

📖 [b]Lore Award: Awarded to the entry with the best lore.[/b]
To win this award, write a backstory about your map and post it in the description of your workshop page!

💥 [b]Catastrophe Award: Awarded to the entry with the most unique catastrophe idea.[/b]
To win this award, build a castle catastrophe that is distinctive and unexpected - the most unique idea will prevail!

The winner of each award will receive a DLC set of their choice, as well as their name added to the description of a Creative Mode structure!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/020d2e5d52aede0f1c0656b981f556e200c80825.jpg[/img]
[h1]✔️ Participate in just 5 steps:[/h1]
1️⃣ Use Witch It's Creative Mode to build a custom map following our theme, rules and advice!
2️⃣ Upload your map to the Steam workshop!
3️⃣ Upload [b]at least one[/b] screenshot onto your workshop page!
4️⃣ Add the hashtag [b]#mapcontest2024[/b] in the description!
5️⃣ Finally, post your entry in [url=https://www.discord.gg/witchit]#map-contest on the Witch It Discord server[/url] or under this Steam announcement!

By participating, you are agreeing that we can use your creation as an official featured map in Witch It.

📚 [i]Are you still unsure what to do? [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2203730812]View our detailed participation guide here![/url][/i]

[h1]⚠️ [Important!] Rules[/h1]
🔸 You must build on an empty map containing no structures (interior, town day, island day, town night, ice day, graveyard night, magical forest, desert day, desert sunset, jungle day, or dream valley day)!
🔸 If you wish to build on a default map containing pre-made structures, you must build out-of-bounds!
🔸 You can submit as many maps as you want, but remember: quality over quantity.
🔸 You can either make your map solo, or collaborate with up to 3 other creators - [b]all creators must be marked a contributor[/b] to your workshop item!
🔸 You cannot enter using other creator's maps that you are not an original contributor on (we will check for stolen work).
🔸 You must design an entirely original map - it cannot be based on an existing map from another game!
🔸 Offensive/NSFW content is strictly prohibited!
🔸 All users can enter, including Grand Architect and staff members. Users with ongoing bans are not eligible to win.
🔸 Absolutely no AI-generated content (for graphics/screenshots/lore). Be creative!

⚠️ [b]Fairness Change:[/b] One creator cannot win the main prize twice in a single map contest - only your best map will be chosen, the rest will not be eligible! This change does not apply to the additional prizes.

⚠️ Switches are allowed in maps.

⚠️ If you're building in out-of-bounds water, the physics of the water do not work properly and therefore will be unbalanced for gameplay. For this reason, please [b]avoid[/b] using out-of-bounds water in the playable areas of your maps.

[i]Breaking these rules may result in disqualification from the contest![/i]

[h1]Advice[/h1]
📕 [b]Balance Your Map[/b]
Ensure your map is fun to play for both teams by considering balance in your creative decisions. Do the witches have plenty of hiding options? Can hunters check for witches efficiently? Above all else, balance is often carried by map size - too small, and Hunters will find it too easy, too big and witches will almost always win. Try to strike a balance for both teams!

While there is no strict rule on player count for your map, we strongly recommend aiming for a map size that supports 4-10 players. This way, if you build bigger than you anticipated, your map may still be balanced for 8-16 players.

📙 [b]Playtesting Is Key[/b]
Round up your friends (or even other entrants) to test your maps thoroughly. A great looking map will be not be approved if the gameplay mechanics are inconsistent or broken. Watch out for things such as stairs that don't work, ladders that can't be climbed, doorways that are too small. Switches are permitted, but not necessary for most maps.

📒 [b]Optimise Your Maps[/b]
Optimise your prop and utility use to ensure your map is smooth to run. A well optimised map often has less than 500 props, any amount of structures, no utilities stacked on top of each other (e.g multiple lights in one position), and no unstable frozen props that jump away erratically when touched. If you are building in a map containing out-of-bounds water, the physics of the water does not work properly and therefore should be avoided in playable areas of your maps.

📗 [b]Broken Hiding Spots[/b]
Combining structures together can occasionally lead to small gaps which props can fit into. Often, this happens with world boundaries, rocks, and ice structures - but can easily be avoided by vigorously checking intersections of structures (don't forget: playtest!). Even just one small gap in a structure may break your map, as witches can use these areas to avoid hunters with no risk. Please keep this in mind during and after the creation of your entry.

📘 [b]Gamemode Compatibility[/b]
Your map must be compatible with Hide & Seek, Mobification and Hunt a Hag. Please consider using a variety of props and gameplay options for both teams, and take into account the skills each team may use.

[h1]⌛ Deadline[/h1]
We are closing entries on [b]Wednesday, 15th January 2025 (midday, 12:00pm UTC)[/b]!
Once the contest ends, we will take time reviewing every entry and deciding on the winners, which will be revealed shortly after.

We hope you enjoy Castle Catastrophe! [i]#mapcontest2024[/i]

notes.title: Witch It: Overflow Mode
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/7fa11d471f52ae093c194ac73fffe67f260bf0b7.png[/img]
In the past 24 hours, we've had over [b]80,000+ unique players[/b] open Witch It across all platforms, and hit our highest-ever [b]concurrent playercount at over 17,000+[/b]! 🎉

To keep up with the huge influx of new players, Witch It is currently in [b]"Overflow Mode"[/b].
Overflow Mode aims to let as many players into the game as possible by limiting some functionality of the game. 🔒

[h3]Overflow Mode Includes:[/h3]
✔️ Quick Match
✔️ Server List
✔️ Friends System
✔️ Custom Matches
✔️ Creative Mode

[h3]Overflow Mode Does Not Include:[/h3]
❌ Progression
❌ Skins
❌ Inventory
❌ Quests
❌ Crafting
❌ Trading
❌ Achievements

We feel Overflow Mode is necessary to ensure as many players as possible can play Witch It over the weekend and limit further server crashes. We aim to keep Witch It in Overflow Mode at least until the end of the weekend, but may extend it further if it remains stable.

Your progression and items you have earned previously to Overflow Mode are safe, and will be accessible again once we exit Overflow Mode. [b]Levels earned in Overflow Mode will not be saved.[/b]

⚠️ [b]DLC Packs will not work in Overflow Mode.[/b] If you have bought DLC, it is safe and you will be [b]able to access it again once we leave Overflow Mode[/b].

While this is not the most ideal solution, we would like to assure you our team is working tirelessly on maintaining the servers. We've never experienced such large numbers before, and so it's been a huge challenge for us to keep everything stable! 🤯

We plan to extend our ongoing events [i](Dreamland and Halloween)[/i], and we will compensate all players with crafting ingredients in the next few weeks.

We'd like to extend a special thanks to our community regulars in helping new players and supporting our team with additional support in and out of the game. You are amazing! 💜

[i]~ Barrel Roll Games[/i]

notes.title: Patch 1.6.0.3 - Halloween 2024!
notes.content:
[b]Trick-or-treat![/b] It's that time of the year again. 🎃
To put you in the mood for Halloween, we've added the [b]Scare Luaq[/b] witch set, a brand-new [b]limited-time icon[/b], new [b]material variants for windows[/b] and more. Read on! 👻

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/d7b35591ad63054953b6099f2e2bc0c7ac75b842.jpg[/img]
[h1]Scare Luaq![/h1]
Luaq fans - this one is for you! 💜
Dress up as the handcrafted [b]Scare Luaq[/b] and strike terror (or charm) into your foes! 🧟‍♀️

😈 [b]Scare Luaq's Straw Hat[/b]
😈 [b]Scare Luaq's Head[/b]
😈 [b]Scare Luaq's Suit[/b]
😈 [b]Scare Luaq's Broom[/b]

Collect these four very rare Witch items through Halloween crafting (explained below)!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/4e0f28eafbf879b9f04b1a1d019b022e8b942416.jpg[/img]
[h2]How do I obtain Halloween items?[/h2]
Opening Witch It during the Halloween 2024 event will grant you [b]40 "Gloomkins"[/b]!
A Gloomkin contains a [b]random[/b] Halloween item (including Halloween items from previous years), which can only be opened by combining them with [b]"Haunted Candy"[/b]. 🍬

To earn Haunted Candies, [b]fill up the Item Cauldron with 250 experience points[/b]. You can see the item cauldron fill up at the end of the round, on the level up screen.

Haunted Candy has a [b]60% chance[/b] of being earned on any Official server once the item cauldron is filled, but must be earned on specific Halloween maps: [b]Sleeping Rose Cemetery, Cursed Ruins, Grunewald Library or Grave Gulch[/b]. If you're lucky enough to earn one, head back to the main menu and press [b]'Halloween Event'[/b] to combine it with a Gloomkin!

Every Halloween 2024 item earned through Gloomkins are [b]tradable and craftable[/b] even after the event is over. If you use up all your Gloomkins, you can craft more by combining 5 Haunted Candy together! 🍭
[i]Note: Haunted Candy can only be obtained in Official servers.[/i]

[b]You can also receive the new items through:[/b]
- Random drops from filling up the item cauldron at the end of a round.
- Trading with other players ([url=https://www.discord.gg/witchit]we recommend using our Discord server to find traders[/url]).

[h1]Halloween 2024 Player Icon![/h1]
Searching for an icon to match your new sets? Check out our brand-new [b]Halloween 2024 limited-time icon[/b]! 🦇

Play at least [b]one round[/b] of Witch It in an Official server during the Halloween 2024 event to earn the icon, but be quick - after the event ends, [b]it will no longer be obtainable[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/4b1a537ffd6fc34558f0793e4d3bee3480696e60.jpg[/img]
[h1]Window Materials![/h1]
Give your structures life with tons of new window materials! 🪟
Place down the classic [b]"Wood window"[/b] structure, then select it in edit mode to change it's frame and interior. Use this to spice up your latest maps and layouts!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/7acf3ced52269687b233d60b5944067c216c8baa.gif[/img]

[h2]Official Map Contest 2024 Update![/h2]
The Official Map Contest 2024 is just around the corner! 🏗️

If you're interested in having your creation added to Witch It's in-game map pool for many years to come, then keep an eye out for our contest announcement in the upcoming weeks! At the start of the contest, we will reveal a theme that you must build - our themes are ideal for both new and returning map creators, so please come and give it a try once the contest begins! 👷

Never made a map before? [i]Don't sweat![/i] 💦
Witch It's Creative Mode is easy to pick up and learn. Give it a shot by pressing "Play" then "Creative mode" in the main menu. Who knows - you might find out you're a natural architect!

notes.title: Patch 1.6.0 - Dreamland!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/f1d9d4751f88a02c62b875c9f60f40844d716037.png[/img]
[previewyoutube=2N-AJz18wRo;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]✨ [b]Welcome to Dreamland[/b], Witch It's biggest and most extraordinary update ever! ✨[/h2]

Venture into [b]Dream Valley Castle[/b], a masterfully crafted map brimming with beautiful architecture for you to explore and hide within! Adorn yourself in [b]48 fancy Dreamland skins[/b], while you collect over [b]70+ wonderful fantasy-inspired props[/b] sprinkled throughout the map! For the Creative types - we've introduced over [b]200+ new structures to Creative Mode[/b], so you can finally satisfy your desire to build your own kingdoms and castles! 🏰

Before we share what we've been working on, we want to express our immense gratitude for your patience while we've worked tirelessly on Dreamland and our upcoming console releases - [i]thank you![/i] Dreamland is our most ambitious project yet, so we truly hope you enjoy what we've created! 💜

[h1]Dream Valley Castle![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/c02b2d1e0dadf3b1b0102f1e8bbd99987a51a8e4.png[/img]
Dream Valley Castle is the result of over a year of groundbreaking technical progress and collaborative team growth. We think this map captures the magical and wacky charm of Witch It more than anything we've ever made! Bring your friends, as this is one of our biggest maps to date. 🗺️

[i]Let's take a look at what Dream Valley Castle has to offer...[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/db239cb2817ff11f85ddf0dc2ea020c5a1f25c0c.png[/img]

[h2]The Courtyard[/h2]
Welcome to the courtyard! The area is divided into four distinct segments, linked by winding corridors and castle walls. At its core, the mysterious Witch Tower looms over the map... 🧙‍♀️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/f15f333000ea464192ec93bcb5181d45d558ee87.png[/img]

[h2]The Seasons[/h2]
In the courtyard, each segment brings a different season to life, complete with themed props and structures unique to that time of the year. Seamlessly travel between each area by using the portals located at the centre of each seasonal zone! 🌀

[h3]🌸 Spring[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/49fce450e1eba0eba807046c7d84d94d44df3065.png[/img]

[h3]☀️ Summer[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/2f03b4299a0077b8fbef60e6b37a0e91e1a8c5c5.png[/img]

[h3]🍂 Autumn[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/ef349484e97695e0f95ab0c2c25fe632ad32eab3.png[/img]

[h3]❄️ Winter[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/4f3660d5f4625c0e001e7f34925d79c8ba20b7a5.png[/img]

[h2]The Witch Tower[/h2]
Venture into the mystifying Witch Tower at the centre of the courtyard. Hide up high and out of sight of hunters - the unpredictable magic infesting the tower provides the perfect cover from even the most talented opponents! 🔮

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/6eedd1abd5c9263293e4fec43068cfb0ff48be59.png[/img]

[h2]The Castle[/h2]
Take cover within the castle's beautiful architecture and furnishings, using balconies and rafters to outsmart the hunters! Escape quickly through the corridors, or via the huge double doors leading directly into the Autumn zone. 🕯️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/16ccec0148291fe343e9843629583fa0082c13fe.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/1ee4372b9fa8d8da1ff0632c2734fbcf5fead202.png[/img]

[h1]70+ New Props![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/c02b2d1e0dadf3b1b0102f1e8bbd99987a51a8e4.png[/img]
Adapt to the surroundings in Dream Valley Castle by transforming into any one of the 70+ new props scattered across the map. Transform into various weaponry, potions, or even disguise yourself in Knight's armour! Blend in effortlessly with the seasonal zones by switching into bushes, beans, or one of the many secret props tucked away out-of-sight! ⚔️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/ea8b84e5141bb562c2b5cfa50d4c44885b407cce.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/766f3a6703b660a7c92867446fcc5b6724052bd5.jpg[/img]

We can't wait for you to explore Dream Valley Castle and discover the framed paintings of our outstanding [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/559650/view/4210379328704313133?l=english]Dreamland Art Contest[/url] winners! 🖼️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/948c1602d432d43fc22adcfbf08f7bcf78dcec95.jpg[/img]

[b]Once again, congratulations to our Horizontal Frame Winners:[/b]
🥇 [b]1st Place:[/b] Morinor
🥈 [b]2nd Place:[/b] Andy
🥉 [b]3rd Place:[/b] DrRiptide

[b]As well as our Vertical Frame Winners:[/b]
🥇 [b]1st Place:[/b] Vissia
🥈 [b]2nd Place:[/b] Fánkiii
🥉 [b]3rd Place:[/b] gedankenkind

As always, thanks to everyone who participated! [url=https://imgur.com/gallery/dreamland-art-contest-entries-gDjKanL]You can view all entries here.[/url] 👀

[h1]200+ New Creative Mode Structures![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/c02b2d1e0dadf3b1b0102f1e8bbd99987a51a8e4.png[/img]
While building Dream Valley Castle, we wanted to empower our map creators with all the essential parts and pieces, so that everyone has the chance to build their own kingdom! Discover more than 200 new arches, towers, walls, bridges, windows, flora, statues, and much more! 🧱

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/d09276ba6dcd2c749506ae5c58aaba01cbc8d7d8.png[/img]

While you get acquainted with the new Creative Mode structures, we're working on 2024's Official Map Contest which will arrive before the end of the year! If you can't wait that long, join the [url=https://www.discord.gg/witchit]Witch It Discord[/url] and prepare for the next community-ran Speed Build contest, arriving a few weeks from now! 💨

[h2]Creative Mode QoL[/h2]
We've made a bunch of useful quality-of-life changes to Creative Mode:
[list]
[*] Change your camera speed by scrolling your mouse wheel.
[*] Save a selection with ALT + [NUMBER] [list][*] You can select the previously saved selection by pressing the corresponding number once.
[*] Centre the previously saved selection by pressing the corresponding number twice.[/list] [*] Move your camera downwards by using "C".
[*] Moving props around using the gizmo now follows your mouse speed (no more repeated dragging)!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/d608e2f16290b29e640c5cc2a34615024d71032a.gif[/img]

In addition, we've added many more [b]material overrides[/b] to many of the Dreamland structures - for example, towers placed in a desert map will look different to towers placed in an island map. You can also manually set the material variant using Edit Mode! ⛏️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/2b4f0c0b6375925b7d515b4ac6aee9ec2dedceaf.gif[/img]

[h1]48 New Skins![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/c02b2d1e0dadf3b1b0102f1e8bbd99987a51a8e4.png[/img]
If you're running around Dream Valley Castle, please come properly dressed (we don't want to upset the King)! Dress up as the marvellous King himself, or an enchanted fairy that blends in with the seasons... or even one of the many horses (don't forget to attach a horn)! All skins can be earned through event crafting, explained below. 🧵

[h3]👑 Kings & Knights[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/8fe8e78860a61b8f28182e08996c864cda2f1891.jpg[/img]

[h3]🧚‍♀️ Fairies & Granddaughters[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/2908a46078a3eef9c39156c078da63c1a0f4e73c.jpg[/img]

[h3]🐴 Horses & Horns[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/01f5a5b1faff2144df05f1f7938f4280949c1317.jpg[/img]

[h2]How do I craft Dreamland items?[/h2]
Opening Witch It during the Dreamland event will grant you [b]30 "Jewellery Boxes"![/b]
A Jewellery Box contains a [b]random Dreamland item[/b], which can only be opened by combining them with "Dreamy Fluff".

To earn Dreamy Fluffs, [b]fill up the Item Cauldron with 250 experience points[/b]. You can see the item cauldron fill up at the end of the round, on the level-up screen.

Dreamy Fluff has a [b]50% chance[/b] of being earned on any Official server once the item cauldron is filled, but only if you are currently playing [b]Dream Valley Castle[/b]! If you're lucky enough to earn one, head back to the main menu and press [b]"Dreamland"[/b] to combine it with a Jewellery Box!

Every Dreamland item earned through Jewellery Boxes are [b]tradable and craftable[/b] even when the Dreamland event is over. If you use up all your Jewellery Boxes, you can craft more by combining 5 Dreamy Fluff in the event screen.
[i]Note: Dreamy Fluff can only be obtained in Official servers.[/i]

[b]You can also receive the new items through:[/b]
- As random drops from filling up the item cauldron at the end of a round.
- Trading with other players (we recommend using our [url=https://www.discord.gg/witchit]Discord server[/url] to find traders).

[h2]Dreamland Event Icon[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/b308b4e1a288b6f495d4360903628bf7f8374229.jpg[/img]
Collect the limited-time [b]"Dreamland Event"[/b] icon by playing Witch It during the event season. At the end of the Dreamland event, this icon will never return, so make sure to pick it up before it disappears! ⌛

[h1]DLC Rarity & New Sets![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/c02b2d1e0dadf3b1b0102f1e8bbd99987a51a8e4.png[/img]
With the introduction of our new [b]DLC rarity[/b], we will be releasing two new DLC sets:

[b]Introducing the Time Keeper, and Moon Sorceress![/b] ⏰ 🌙

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/9da8c672a25ad085d172629a751e4f87a4f2fd87.jpg[/img]

These sets will be released [b]within the next few weeks[/b], and purchasable as a bundle or seperately via the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/559650/Witch_It/]Witch It Steam store page[/url]! ✔️

[i]The Time Keeper and Moon Sorceress will be permanently available, and are not tradable or smashable.[/i]

notes.title: Patch 1.5.1 - In-game Trading!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/709d386014f5f3fc2bc895382e2f1fff0fd14ac3.png[/img]

[b]We're excited to announce Patch 1.5.1![/b] Send and receive trade offers by using our new in-game trading system, now set-up for cross-platform trading once Witch It releases on consoles later this year. View your inventory in-game, try our new aim-assist for gamepads, and witness improved performance on older PC's. Read on! 🎉

[h2]Everything You Need To Know About In-Game Trading:[/h2]
[h3]Enable Public Inventory[/h3]
In order to receive trade offers, you must first toggle your Witch It account settings to ensure your inventory is visible. To find your account settings, press on your username in the main menu, then press the last tab with the cog icon. Here, you can enable your public inventory:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/33d2e4f4f5795c990ddc5ecdfbd1112651774115.gif[/img]

Our brand-new in-game trading system can be found under [b]"Collection"[/b] > [b]"Trading"[/b] on our new restructured main menu. ⚙️

On this screen, you will find three options to create trade requests, see pending requests, and view your trade history. 🔎

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/4372a05cd6c0d28d75b33048d527b2c99157f280.jpg[/img]
[h3]Create Trade Request[/h3]
Press [b]"Create Trade Request"[/b] to open a list containing all your Witch It friends. 🤝

To initiate a trade request, press the handshake icon corresponding with the friend you wish to trade with. In the future, we will add a way for you to trade with non-friends, too!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/f3c724a9fc303a872630cc501750e6c9991c3cfe.jpg[/img]

Select items to trade from your inventory by clicking on them under the [b]"Mine"[/b] tab. You can see the active trade offer to the right, and if you want to remove an item just click on it in the offer!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/0c203562318c67489c9727c2990bbb5f4768952d.jpg[/img]

Select items from their inventory by clicking on them under the [b]"Theirs"[/b] tab. Once you're ready to send the offer, press [b]"Send Trade Offer"[/b] in the bottom right! ✔️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/b979f9cf6f3b1c22d13c0ee753f2f0ec354e7313.jpg[/img]

[b]Important Tips:[/b]
- If you are trading away the last of an item you own, a warning triangle will appear around the item quantity. Be careful not to trade away any items you wish to keep! ⚠️
- If an item in an offer is traded away elsewhere, all offers containing that item will automatically cancel. Be careful not to trade away identical items in multiple trades! ❌
- Both players do not need to be online in order to receive or accept trade offers - you can send requests to offline players! 💤

[i][url=https://witchtrade.org/]We plan to support WitchTrade in the future! 💜[/url][/i]

[h3]Pending Trade Requests[/h3]
Press [b]"Pending Trade Requests"[/b] to view all incoming and outgoing trade requests. 📬

On the [b]"Incoming"[/b] tab, you can see incoming requests, and accept or reject these by pressing the corresponding buttons to the right of the offer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/1b1b2efd1c5089cfd59a9feeef3139a04caa214d.jpg[/img]

On the [b]"Outgoing"[/b] tab, you can see your outgoing requests. Cancel a request by pressing the corresponding button to the right of the offer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/e7f3ebf688d153b3ea9f198ba16aa5ea993bef0b.jpg[/img]

Incoming trading requests will also appear as notifications in-game! 📨

[h3]Trade History[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/606c8b1fd3416635ade46d6a05db1cb79b3c128a.jpg[/img]

Press [b]"Trade History"[/b] to view a detailed list of all your previous trades.

Each trade shows the name and icon of the player you were trading with, a timestamp of the trade, whether it was an incoming or outgoing trade, and the status of the trade. Clicking on a trade will allow you to see what items were swapped, in case you need a quick reminder! 🔄

[h2]Inventory[/h2]
View your entire Witch It inventory by pressing on [b]"Collection"[/b] > [b]"Inventory"[/b]. 👀

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/8f381df65c68de8b0dbc923a79043f994a64b4aa.jpg[/img]

Press the [b]"Filter"[/b] button to filter your inventory by type, team, slot, rarity, or duplicates!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/cb69071e1e7c69be34b617ba8511dd2d282c4d82.jpg[/img]

Your Steam Inventory is still invisible, as we are still working on solutions for displaying your items without causing issues to our cross-platform system. 🪲

[h2]Aim Assist[/h2]
Struggling to hit fast-moving witches with your controller? 🎮
We've now added an aim assist to help you secure those eliminations!
[i]Aim assist does not work with mouse and keyboard - only gamepads.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/3dae17c7f3173d762587b7a78540d1f142716b0a.gif[/img]

Aim assist does not lock onto still transformed props, so don't worry - your hiding spot is safe (probably)!

[h2]Portal Effects[/h2]
We've mixed together the finest and rarest ingredients into our portal fluid, releasing a satisfying burst of particles whenever you travel through them! 💫

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/d46d6b06c5be31a95487ec6e4e7e42a2d74a4da8.gif[/img]
[h2]Patch Notes:[/h2]
+ Added: Cross platform trading system between friends (found under Collection->Trading. We are aware of some missing translations, and are working on it)
+ Added: Inventory screen to check all your items
+ Added: Aim assistance for gamepads to help with those fast Witches
+ Added: Static mesh and skeletal mesh lod (Level of Detail) to improve performance on slow PCs
+ Added: Portal effect when entering and leaving
+ Added: Sensitivity setting for scope mode

✓ Fixed: Witch spawn points on 'Greywood Castle' & 'Ancient Temple'

✓ Fixed: Sleep state now works for the pinwheel props
✓ Fixed: Gravestone collision

✓ Fixed: Many small UI inconsistencies
✓ Fixed: Loading into a match with the same skill twice causing unwanted results

notes.title: Dreamland Art Contest!
notes.content:
7 years ago today, we revealed our first ever art contest, in which our community members designed paintings for [b]Grunewald Library[/b]! 🖌️
Following the contest, three winners had their artwork implemented into Witch It as props, becoming an iconic addition to the game ever since.

We are delighted to finally announce the [b]Dreamland Art Contest[/b] - a monumental competition in which your art could leave an impact on the game for many years to come! ːluaqː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/14c0b94688f574636191f65b2ba46af5528d8cbe.png[/img]
[h2]🏆 Prizes[/h2]
We are looking to add 3 pieces of community art to our [b]upcoming content update: Dreamland![/b] ✨
Entrants will compete for 1st, 2nd and 3rd place judged by Barrel Roll Games and the Community Staff team.

🥇 [b]1st Place[/b] - Your artwork will be placed in a [b]gold frame[/b] and implemented as a playable prop!
🥈 [b]2nd Place[/b] - Your artwork will be placed in a [b]silver frame[/b] and implemented as a playable prop!
🥉 [b]3rd Place[/b] - Your artwork will be placed in a [b]bronze frame[/b] and implemented as a playable prop!

Each winner will also receive a Witch It key to be redeemed on Steam! 🔑

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/fd20127a4e50c07592a1057a30908f2031de493e.png[/img]
[h2]🏰 Theme: Fantasy![/h2]
[b]Dreamland[/b] is heavily inspired by countless fantasy stories and themes.
Ask yourself: how will your artwork fit into Witch It's weird and wacky world? 💫

[h2]🎨 How do I participate?[/h2]
1️⃣ Pick whether you want a horizontal frame, or vertical frame.
You [b]must[/b] create your art in the 8:5/5:8 aspect resolution. Here's our guidelines:

If you're creating artwork for a [b]horizontal[/b] frame: [b]2560px x 1600px[/b], [b]1920px x 1200px[/b] or [b]1280px x 800px[/b].
If you're creating artwork for a [b]vertical[/b] frame: [b]1600px x 2560px[/b], [b]1200px x 1920px[/b] or [b]800px x 1280px[/b].

2️⃣ Design your artwork and export it, ensuring you follow the rules below!
3️⃣ Upload your entry as a .png or .jpg image to [url=https://www.discord.gg/witchit]#art-entries on our Discord server[/url], or post your artwork underneath this Steam announcement!

[b]You are allowed to name your artwork, but please note that we may change their names if used.[/b]

[h2]📜 Rules [Important!][/h2]
- Your artwork must relate to Witch It in some form.
- You must submit your artwork in the 8:5 or 5:8 aspect ratio (please see our guidelines above). If you win, your artwork will be [b]downscaled[/b] to 128 x 80 or 80 x 128 based on Witch It's prop constraints, so please be mindful when adding intricate details - they might not appear in-game!
- You must own all elements of your art. Do not use (or commission) pictures or elements created by other people (Witch It content is fine to use)!
- Entry file format must be .png or .jpg.
- Your entry must follow our rules - no offensive content!
- Make sure your artwork fits the art style of Witch It.
- You can submit [b]2[/b] entries maximum - but your second entry must be in a different resolution (for example, if you submitted a vertical painting, you can only create a horizontal painting next)!
- All users can enter, including previous contest winners and community staff.
- You can collaborate with other entrants if you wish, but be aware that this will count as an entry for all artists involved. Please list all collaborators alongside your entry!

🔨 [i]Breaking these rules may result in disqualification from the contest![/i]

[h2]❌ Generative AI Warning[/h2]
Absolutely [b]no full or partial AI-generated artwork[/b] is allowed to be submitted for this contest.
We may ask you for [b]proof of creation[/b], such as a [u]layered file[/u] or [u]progress pictures[/u]. If you can't provide at least one of these on request, your entry will be void. ⚠️

By posting your entry, you are agreeing that we can use your creation in the future in any form! ✔️

[h2]⌛ Contest Deadline[/h2]
Entries will close on [b]7th April 2024 @ 11pm (UTC)[/b]!
Winners will be revealed within a few weeks after the deadline.

Good luck, artists! 🎉

notes.title: Patch 1.5.0 - Creative 2.0!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/917153b010dc84f86ba9d24d89ac35cef1ace2d9.png[/img]

[b]Patch 1.5.0 is here![/b] In this update, we're excited to release an early version of our Creative 2.0 that will advance your map creation to unimaginable heights! In addition, we now have a new in-game friends system, and have made a lot of performance optimisations towards CPU and GPU. Check it out! 🎉

[h2]Creative 2.0![/h2]
Welcome to Creative 2.0, our biggest technical leap to Creative Mode yet! 🚀

You'll immediately notice that Creative 2.0's camera works slightly different from usual. You now use right-click to rotate your camera. This is to keep our creative mode mechanically aligned with other popular creative modes and editing software, and will be much easier for console players to build maps once we enable controller use in the near future. 🕹️

By pressing Tab, you can now open a radial menu that allows you to select from Place, Edit, or Connect modes seamlessly:

[h3]🪑 Place Mode[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/ad46a11ff44803d75555551356cfc25f62788b1b.jpg[/img]
Place Mode is used to place down props, structures and utilities into your map. In Creative 2.0, the placement menu has been condensed so you don't ever have to open and close the menu to see what you're doing. Your position in the placement menu will remain even after placing a prop (unless switching to another tab or mode), allowing for far more efficiency when you go to fill up your maps with props!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/6d7bf56c966b3be7bca44cd991681466089b904f.jpg[/img]

[h3]🔧 Edit Mode[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/a7a98fada4579550e1c1eeea84c2a3ee6c1f3f07.jpg[/img]
Edit Mode is used to modify specific parameters of your props. As usual, you can click a prop to select it for editing - however, you'll now see a useful properties menu appear in the corner of your screen. For the first time ever since Creative Mode was released, you can now type in specific values for position, rotation and scaling, allowing for mathematically accurate transformation of any prop or structure in your map.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/a26f3265e5e2823870dd58521efdd0ab31354b60.jpg[/img]
[i]Want to equally space out pillars in a building?[/i]
Increase one of the position values by 200 each time to create a perfect row! ✔️

[i]Want to create a structures like Twisted House?[/i]
Modify the rotation value and copy it to all other props to create weird and wacky designs! ✔️

[i]Need to enable an action prop?[/i]
Action props can be activated directly in edit mode! ✔️

[h3]🔌 Connect Mode[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/e74c6f48f997e6550bd002812aadb0aeea5b1248.jpg[/img]
Connect Mode is used to attach switches to switchable props or utilities. In Creative 2.0, you can connect and disconnect objects by shift-clicking them. Easily view all connections on a single switch by selecting the switch in connect mode, and disconnect all or selected connections via the menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/6ea48b35d2a9ed9003a7e5ffed124a27db2388e2.jpg[/img]

[h3]🎮 Play Test[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/52e7ff35fa44aa1966c027b226534d32ea9634fd.jpg[/img]

Creative 2.0's Play Test mode allows you to test your creations and push their limits without damaging your hard work. When enabling Play Test via the server menu (ESC), you can now select your team and skills before starting the test. Physics are disabled by default in Creative 2.0, so Play Test is what you'll use to quickly enable physics and test your maps exactly as players will see it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/461347ec91978b8d5eab12846356b7e30fa4b2c2.jpg[/img]
After starting the test, you can run around and play your maps as you wish. Knocking over props, using explosive skills like body slam, and breaking your maps is encouraged - as exiting Play Test will revert everything back to normal and return your props to their original positions! ↩️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/d0ceedd25b8664ba19269408287b40b6bd3afd07.jpg[/img]
Please be aware that this an early iteration of the new Creative Mode, so many things are still not yet finalised. In particular, controller and chat functions do not currently work and will be added in a later update. But there's good news - the Creative Mode structure limit has now been [b]increased from 2000 to 2500![/b] 🧱

Here's some handy shortcut keys that may help you in Creative 2.0:

[b]Press 4[/b] to change to Place Mode
[b]Press 5[/b] to change to Edit Mode
[b]Press 6[/b] to change to Connect Mode
[b]Press 0[/b] to change to Play Test Mode

[h2]Friends System![/h2]
With the upcoming console release and exploration of new platforms for Witch It, we are introducing a new in-game friends list. You can access it by pressing your profile in the top right of the main menu, or by opening the in-game menu during a match and pressing 'Friends'. 👥

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/8ce3d9488488ef8c69cf74066d204b3d0215f591.jpg[/img]
Here, you can browse your list of in-game, online and offline friends. If you're currently in a match, you'll also have an option to invite your friend to the session. In this menu, you can also find recently played with players, pending friend invites, and account settings. ⚙️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/777a2cf35e8dc787be799f7640734f2d5ecd5a96.jpg[/img]
In account settings, you can reveal your User ID and share with your friends to add them! ➕
Adding in-game friends does not affect your Steam friends list.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/374a112141711c9a65f875e22e4c95a69b787411.jpg[/img]

[h2]Major Optimisations![/h2]
Players with low-end integrated graphics cards can now select the new "Start with Simple Shaders" launch option when starting Witch It, which will improve performance on old PCs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/a4955ec28cb517f7ba229fd4c9b48b8b445c53be.png[/img]
Map collision has been entirely replaced with our new map border system, and we made several optimisations on gamecode which will improve CPU performance. 📈

[h2]Prop Transform Grace Time[/h2]
In the in-game settings, there's a new option called "Prop Transform Grace Time". ✨
This refers to the amount of time you can transform into a prop even after it's not highlighted anymore.
While this is mainly for controller users to make it easier to transform while moving, this works just as well for PC players too!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/30144670cd6f78eec8d251d28b68dcebb418da8d.gif[/img]

[h2]Patch Notes:[/h2]

1.5.0 - Creative Mode Update

+ Added: There is now a Simple Shader Mode for low end integrated graphics cards which will increase performance
+ Added: In-game friends system - You can now see your friends list and people you recently played with. Friends added via the new system are only friends within Witch It, they will not affect your Steam friends. To access the new system the button in the top right corner of the main menu has been replaced (you can change your icons under “Collection”)

↻ Changed: Several optimisations on gamecode which will improve CPU performance
↻ Changed: Replaced all Mapcollision with our new Map border system
↻ Changed: Witches can no longer get the invisibility Power-Up in Fill-A-Pot
↻ Changed: Invisibility Power-Up duration got reduced from 12 to 7 Seconds
↻ Changed: Updated the Ingame Help Screen for Controllers
↻ Changed: Increased Structure Limit in Creative Mode from 2000 to 2500
↻ Changed: Map border around the ship on ‘Port Plunder’ 

✓ Fixed: Broken spots on 'Grave Gulch' & 'Bone Pit'
✓ Fixed: Possess working on dissolving props

By the way, please follow our new [b]Instagram[/b] page!
https://www.instagram.com/witchitgame

notes.title: Patch 1.4.5 - Year of the Dragon & Valentine's 2024!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/619844d0476da2a3bfe2ee2801def0a9848c7bcb.jpg[/img]
新年好!

[b]The Year of the Dragon is here[/b], and we're marking the occasion with new skins, props, power-ups, and more! And for the romantics among us, we have some Valentine's surprises too... read on! 🐲

[h2]4 New Skins![/h2]
Introducing the [b]Wood Dragon Head[/b] for the Witch, and the [b]Red Envelope[/b] for the Hunter, two beautiful new Chinese New Year skins for you to earn via event crafting! For those who want less red and more pink, check out the [b]Romantic Hat[/b] for the Witch and the [b]Valentine's Hat[/b] for the Hunter, granted free to all players who log onto Witch It between 14th - 21st February (when the event ends)! 💞

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/63a6ced71ac94afbac896e651f1f3bbbe9647b06.jpg[/img]
[h3]Earning Chinese New Year 2024 Items:[/h3]
Open Witch It during the Chinese New Year 2024 event to earn 30 "Fireworks". Combining 1 Firework with 1 Gunpowder will craft 1 random Chinese New Year item.

To earn Gunpowder, you must fill up the item cauldron with 250 experience points on any Official server. The item cauldron fills up at the end of each round, during the level up screen. For every item cauldron opened, there is a 50% chance that you'll receive 1 Gunpowder.
[i]Note: Gunpowder can only be obtained in Official servers.[/i]

Alternatively, you can earn Chinese New Year 2024 items by chance through filling up the item cauldron at the end of a round. 🎲

[h2]2 New Player Icons![/h2]
Collect the limited-time [b]"Valentine 2024"[/b] and [b]"Year of the Dragon"[/b] player icons by playing Witch It during the event season. At the end of the Chinese New Year 2024 event, these icons will never return - so make sure to pick them up before they disappear! 🐉

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/27eda38e8f039463d70ae244c2f8a3ef3b43e23c.jpg[/img]

[h2]3 New Props![/h2]
Explore any of our night maps to locate the new [b]Paper Lantern, Long Paper Lantern, and Dragon Firework props[/b] - and don't forget you can use these props to decorate your Creative Mode maps! 🏮

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/e9b66e26afc4c5c4114694f977dee16f3410b11f.jpg[/img]

[h2]Grand Architect's & Speed Builder's Helmets![/h2]
Following the popularity of the GIF Master's Hat, we're introducing the "Grand Architect's Helmet" and "Speed Builder's Helmet"! 👷

🏆 Previous and future winners of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/559650/view/3651893025296433434]Official Map Contests[/url] will receive the [b]Grand Architect's Helmet[/b]!
🏆 Previous and future winners of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/559650/view/3980686873592572446]Speed Build Contests[/url] will receive the [b]Speed Builder's Helmet[/b]!
[i]The exclusive items will also be granted to their respective event organisers.[/i]

Looking to earn one of these incredible helmets? Keep an eye out on our Steam announcements for the latest contest news as it arrives! We also announce the contests on our [url=https://www.discord.gg/witchit]Discord server[/url] - check it out! 📢

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/a6de04a9ec501a0a6ef4e712a5e8575ef145f071.jpg[/img]

[h2]4 New Power-Ups![/h2]
For the first time since their introduction back in 2018, we're excited to reveal 4 brand new power-ups!
We've added [b]2 new Hunter power-ups and 2 new Witch power-ups[/b], designed to spice up your matches and open up new tactical opportunities to turn the tide of a round - these power-ups may be the ultimate difference between a win or a loss! 🧙

[h3]Hunters[/h3]
🐔 [b]Detection[/b]
A helpful chicken perches on the Hunter's head, temporarily alerting them if Witches are nearby!

⏱️ [b]Cooldown Reduction[/b]
Fueled with determination, the Hunter's skill cooldowns are reduced for a short duration!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/bc256b273883bb767b0e9e3aa4f636821e3ef400.gif[/img]

[h3]Witches[/h3]
👁️ [b]Invisibility[/b]
In the blink of an eye, the Witch vanishes for a brief time, allowing them to escape undetected!

🍄 [b]Confusion Wave[/b]
A powerful wave of Witch energy expands into the surrounding area, disorientating nearby Hunters!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/dcbc328802b01538ff69c2dae662c045f484782f.gif[/img]

In addition, power-ups are now tweakable in Match Rules+! ✔️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/4ed687b3d08aef36952ae68271ec34be18650b3d.jpg[/img]

[h2]Patch Notes:[/h2]
+ Added: 4 new Power-ups
+ Added: Power-ups are now tweakable in Match Rules+
+ Added: 2 new Chinese New Year themed skin items
+ Added: 2 new Valentine’s Day themed skin items
+ Added: 3 new event props
+ Added: Serbo-Croatian localization

↻ Changed: Updated Wall collision to our new collision system on 'Northern Whispers' and 'Singing Sanctuary'. More Maps will follow in the next patches.
↻ Changed: Removed some level achievements
↻ Changed: Reorganized mainmenu to be a bit less cluttered
↻ Changed: Login flow is updated to make sure everything is loaded when the main menu is shown

✓ Fixed: Possess is not showing why it is not possible

✓ Fixed: Power-ups dropped from Witches getting launched when a Witch is caught

[b]Edit:[/b]
⚠️ Just a heads up - we have been made aware of a bug that causes the item cauldron to not always show all drops you have received. For example, you may have been earning gunpowder without realising it! But don't worry, the actual inventory is correct, so any drops you can't see will appear on your account regardless. We'll be fixing this as soon as possible. ✔️

notes.title: Temporary Trading Pause Reminder
notes.content:
[h3]⚠️ On 24th January 2024, Witch It Steam Trading will be removed, and will be replaced with in-game trading a month or two later. ⚠️[/h3]

As outlined in our recent announcement, Witch It Steam Trading will be [b]removed tomorrow, 24th January 2024[/b], and will be [b]replaced with in-game trading[/b] in a few months!

No action is required from you, as all your items are safe! 🔒

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/559650/view/3871471412480839945]➡️ For more information as well as an FAQ, please click here![/url]

[h3]Inventory Visibility[/h3]
During the transition of the Witch It inventory to our own servers, we will be temporarily disabling Witch It's Steam Inventory for an [b]expected 1-2 weeks[/b], following our patch arriving next week. This means your items will not be visible on your Steam profiles, but will be visible once the transition is complete. Again, no action is required from you, and you will be able to display your items as normal once we're confident that everything is working as intended.

We appreciate your patience and understanding! 💜

notes.title: Witch It Temporary Trading Pause (2024)
notes.content:
Today, we are sharing important information regarding the future of Witch It item trading.

In 2024, we are releasing Witch It to consoles as part of a long-term plan to support our game for years to come! You may have noticed a lot of changes recently in preparation of this, as we move away from Steam's systems to our own.

As a result, we are making some major changes to Witch It's item trading.

[h3]⚠️ On 24th January 2024, Witch It Steam Trading will be [u]removed[/u], and will be [u]replaced[/u] with in-game trading a month or two later. ⚠️[/h3]

First and foremost, [b]your items are safe![/b] We are working on a multi-platform trading system that will allow Witch It players to transfer items safely and securely in-game, no matter what platform you are playing Witch It on.

[h2]📝 FAQ[/h2]
[i]Why can't you have both Steam trading and in-game trading?[/i]
To proceed with in-game trading, we must transfer some functionality away from Steam onto our own systems, which will mean Steam trading will not be possible.

[i]Will I still be able to trade Witch It items with items from other games?[/i]
No, the in-game system will only include Witch It items.

[i]Will my items be visible in my Steam Inventory?[/i]
Yes, your items will still be visible in your Steam Inventory.
We also plan to make all items visible once again, including those which were previously hidden!

[i]What about WitchTrade?[/i]
Our team will be reaching out soon to ensure WitchTrade has our support when in-game trading is released!

[i]Will I be compensated?[/i]
We're currently exploring into ways to compensate players who support us through our trading pause - stay tuned!

[h2]🎉 Good News[/h2]
We are confident that once these changes are made, Witch It's trading will be in a far better state than before:
- All items will soon be visible in your Steam Inventory.
- Item farming will be disincentivized.
- Many new traders will be welcomed with the first console release.
- No trade holds.
- Limitless control over new trading functionality - we can expand our in-game trading system based on your feedback!
- New exclusive items will be introduced in 2024, including a hat for Grand Architects, and a hat for Speed Build Contest winners!

If you have any further questions or concerns, please let us know in the comments. 💬

notes.title: Patch 1.4.4 - Winterdream 2023!
notes.content:
[b]Winterdream is back for 2023![/b] Celebrate the festivities with our limited-time event, new skins, recipes, a player icon, new props and more! And as always - [url=https://store.steampowered.com/itemstore/559650/browse/?filter=all]the Winterdream shop is open for business[/url]! ❄️

[img]https://i.imgur.com/jlsUaXr.gif[/img]

[h2]8 New Winterdream Items![/h2]
Decorate your merry characters with 8 new seasonal items, including the [b]Holiday Hat[/b] and [b]Mrs. Santa's Bun[/b] items for the Witch, and the [b]Antlers[/b] and [b]Mr. Candy[/b] items for the Hunters! Stay away from the pointy ends... 🦌

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/8974d561c7b34c28a3725b9c50539eabf3cdf92d.png[/img]

[h3]Earning Winterdream 2023 Items:[/h3]
Open Witch It during the Winterdream 2023 event to earn 40 "Filled Boots". Combining 1 Filled Boot with 1 Cinnamon Star will craft 1 random Winterdream item (rare, very rare or whimsical).

To earn Cinnamon Stars, you must fill up the item cauldron with 250 experience points while playing one of our Winter maps: Snowbreeze or Fiskersted, Northern Whispers or Wardwell Wintry. The item cauldron fills up at the end of each round, during the level up screen. For every item cauldron opened on Snowbreeze, Fiskersted, Northern Whispers or Wardwell Wintry, there is a 60% chance that you'll receive 1 Cinnamon Star.

Crafting Winterdream items using Filled Boots and Cinnamon Stars grants a ~20% chance of dropping a new Winterdream 2023 skin item. You will receive the new items more often than old ones!

Alternatively, you can earn these items through random drops during gameplay, or by crafting Winterdream item recipes in the Witches' Cauldron. You can also obtain these items through trading - we recommend using our trading channels in our [url=https://www.discord.gg/witchit]Discord server[/url]! 🎁

[h2]New Player Icon![/h2]
Collect the limited-time "Winterdream 2023" icon by playing Witch It during the event season. At the end of Winterdream 2023, the icon will never return - so be quick! ☃️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/245bbfd16783fa300146227972348806b04dbed0.jpg[/img]

[h2]22 New Recipes![/h2]
While they were loading up Santa's sleigh, the elves got caught by a blizzard and huge stacks of their recipes blew away in the wind! Lucky for you, they've now been recovered and can now be earned through in-game drops...

Recipes include the [b]iconic piggy items[/b], the [b]community staff hats/masks[/b] (such as Snowtuft's Sheep Head), and lots of [b]Winterdream items from previous years[/b]! 🎄

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/0b5b06c326efedd2eec748f310a4b970b43cb50e.png[/img]

[h2]8 New Props![/h2]
Explore around our Christmas prop layouts and discover the new Ice Cube, Ice Rectangle, Ice Pyramid, Triangular Ice Prism and Frozen Fruits props! During the event, search for the Gingerbread House and Snow Globe event props to add to your prop collection - and for our most talented collectors, keep your eyes peeled for our new secret prop... 🧊

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/8bdc80608c658a7a96ed54ce60962d0966d483f7.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Patch 1.4.3 - Halloween 2023!
notes.content:
[b]Happy Halloween![/b] Celebrate the spooky festivities with four new Hunter items, a limited-time player icon, performance optimisations, and a Halloween GIF Contest! 👻

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/db3eae558fa22978b8191be99d15e6f181d2150d.png[/img]
[h1]Luaq O'Lanterns![/h1]
Struggling to find a suitable Halloween costume for the Hunter this month? Look no further!

[b]🎃 Luaq O'Lantern's Head
🐰 Luaq O'Lantern's Ears
🎃 Luaq O'Lavender's Face
🐰 Luaq O'Lavender's Ears[/b]

Collect these four [b]very rare[/b] Hunter items through Halloween crafting [i](explained below)[/i]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/8fb4da453ca3d8d15da9cfe0bc84d13776c11f84.png[/img]
[h2]How do I obtain Halloween items?[/h2]
Opening Witch It during the Halloween 2023 event will grant you [b]40 "Gloomkins"[/b]!
A Gloomkin contains a [b]random[/b] Halloween item (including Halloween items from previous years), which can only be opened by combining them with [b]"Haunted Candy"[/b]. 🍬

To earn Haunted Candies, [b]fill up the Item Cauldron with 250 experience points[/b]. You can see the item cauldron fill up at the end of the round, on the level up screen.

Haunted Candy has a [b]60% chance[/b] of being earned on any Official server once the item cauldron is filled, but must be earned on specific Halloween maps: [b]Sleeping Rose Cemetery, Cursed Ruins, Grunewald Library or Grave Gulch[/b]. If you're lucky enough to earn one, head back to the main menu and press [b]'Halloween Event'[/b] to combine it with a Gloomkin!

Every Halloween 2023 item earned through Gloomkins are [b]tradable and craftable[/b] even after the event is over. If you use up all your Gloomkins, you can craft more by combining 5 Haunted Candy together! 🍭
[i]Note: Haunted Candy can only be obtained in Official servers.[/i]

[b]You can also receive the new items through:[/b]
- Random drops from filling up the item cauldron at the end of a round.
- Trading with other players (we recommend using our [url=https://www.discord.gg/witchit]Discord server[/url] to find traders).

[h1]Halloween 2023 Player Icon![/h1]
Loving the Luaq O'Lanterns as much as we do? Pair up a matching [b]limited-time icon[/b]! 🕯️
Play at least [b]one round[/b] of Witch It in an Official server during the Halloween 2023 event to earn the icon, but be quick - after the event ends, [b]it will no longer be obtainable[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/0d0ec82134e5333400b040b570626289d75ae2a5.jpg[/img]
[h1]Addressing Performance![/h1]
We're aware of the performance decrease following the transfer of Witch It to Unreal Engine 5, and are making progress towards optimising. In our previous hotfix, we introduced a new [b]"Reflections"[/b] slider in video settings, which can be lowered to improve performance. We've also resolved the problem where frame rate would decrease over the course of a match, as well as some glitches that were affecting players on lower graphics settings.

If you are reading this and have experienced frame rate problems previously, please try Witch It again following this update and let us know if you've noticed any improvement in your performance! 🖥️

[h1]GIF Contest Reminder![/h1]
There's still over a week left until our 9th GIF contest ends: [b]"Fright Night"[/b]! 🕷️
If you're interested in winning one of three exclusive GIF Masters Hats, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/559650/view/7308837573796645674?l=english]check out the contest details here![/url]
Entries close on [b]Friday, 27th October 2023 at 11pm (UTC)[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/8c7263b7ece1dac0d3383d64bbacd882471f1136.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Patch 1.4.2 - Witch It on Unreal Engine 5!
notes.content:
[b]Patch 1.4.2[/b] marks the start of Witch It's bright future - the introduction of [b]Unreal Engine 5[/b]! In addition, we've improved controller support, and have now made significant progress on many of Witch It's supported languages, as well as added Hungarian, Ukrainian and Galician. Read on! 🎉

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/6855fb4532a98a1c2484b62dcffe9d902cadbabb.jpg[/img]

[h2]Unreal Engine 5[/h2]
As our game grows bigger and better each year, we've been looking for ways to upgrade our technology - so Witch It can remain the best prop hunt experience for many years to come! Unreal Engine 5 empowers us with innovative, new tools to bring our creative vision to life far more efficiently than before. 🚀

The transition to UE5 is mostly seamless for you, the players. Your progress and maps are safe, and you won't see many significant changes to how the game looks and plays at this time, but UE5 will give us far more possibilities in future development!

Witch It now has a [b]new physics engine[/b], which should now feel more stable than before. However, if you find anything that's odd, please do let us know! 📝

[b]What about my computer specifications?[/b]
The introduction of Unreal Engine 5 will improve optimisation on mid-to-high tier computers, [b]but is not compatible with Windows 7 or 8[/b]. [url=https://help.steampowered.com/en/faqs/view/4784-4F2B-1321-800A]As of January 1st, 2024, the Steam Client will no longer run on Windows 7 or Windows 8[/url], so if you are running on an older system, we highly recommend to update it as soon as possible! ✔️

[h2]Improved Controller Support[/h2]
Controller support has been drastically improved across Witch It, and features a new default layout!
Please note that custom key bindings have been reset and will need to be input again.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/49d6603f4da0192f050fbd6b9579d6448853720a.jpg[/img]

Please give it a try and send us your feedback to [url=https://www.discord,gg/witchit]our Discord server[/url], our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/559650/discussions/0/]Steam discussions[/url], or in the comments below this announcement. [b]Creative Mode does not have controller support[/b] at this time - but we're working on it for a future update! 🎮

[h2]Hungarian, Ukrainian and Galician Languages[/h2]
Within a day or two of our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/559650/view/3743110574792099822?l=english]translators announcement[/url], we had over 100 community members reach out to us offering their support towards translating Witch It! Thank you to everyone who reached out to us.

Over the past few weeks, we've been working with many talented new translators on finishing our existing languages. [b]Italian[/b], [b]Korean[/b] and [b]Polish[/b] are now complete, and [b]Danish[/b], [b]Japanese[/b] and [b]Portuguese (Brazil)[/b] are not far from finished! 🌍

We also had many community members reach out for us expressing interest in new languages they'd like to see supported. We're excited to announce that we're now supporting [b]Hungarian[/b], [b]Ukrainian[/b] and [b]Galician[/b], which are available to use in-game. [i]To change your language, go to Settings > Game > Language.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/6fcc55ed7a923157c04035c3395597b47321bb01.jpg[/img]
