notes.title: Patch 1.4.1 - Custom Map Cycles are here!
notes.content:
Behold, [b]Patch 1.4.1[/b]! Introducing [b]custom map cycles[/b], allowing you to create your own combination of different maps when hosting a custom match and save your favourite cycles for later! In addition, we've introduced new ways of keeping track of your achievements, some possess balancing changes, and spinning weathervanes... check it out below! 📢

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/b0aee0a047819a189ca02df5c904da5b1c3d7caf.jpg[/img]
[h2][Important] Stats Transfer[/h2]
All player stats and achievements have now been migrated to our own backend servers instead of Steam. This includes all player progress including levels, prop collection progress, and so on. These stats will automatically transfer upon your first login. ⚠️

If you notice any issues with the stats transfer, please let us know in the comments below this announcement, or in the [url=https://www.discord.gg/witchit]Witch It Discord[/url].

[h2]Custom Map Cycles[/h2]
Custom map cycles are finally here! You now have the option to [b]create, edit, save and load[/b] custom map cycles when hosting a custom match.

Custom map cycles can be made from [b]any combination[/b] of Official, Featured, or Custom maps you've created or subscribed to on the Steam Workshop. 🧰

[h3]Creating a Map Cycle[/h3]
To begin, press the "Edit Map Cycle" button when selecting a map to play on.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/a62daa2c973df28fb64fb29f0effe75b9f363c5e.jpg[/img]
You'll now see a new interface appear on the right. Here is where your map cycle will appear!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/d4e31cb42c9ab318a965da076560b6390ef6e20f.jpg[/img]
Add a map to the cycle by clicking on it in the map list, and remove a map from the cycle by clicking on it in the map cycle preview. Chosen maps display a tick to show that they have been selected. Hit 'Reset' just below the map interface to remove all your choices and start again.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/b23a31efc87e9964ea84ea7cd33bee40c19fda35.jpg[/img]
Select up to 20 maps for your map cycle from any category - mix a few of your favourite Official or Featured maps with a handful of Steam Workshop maps for a undeniably fun time! 🙌

[h3]Saving/Loading Map Cycles[/h3]
Just like [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/559650/view/3713823860119034973?l=english]Match Rules +[/url], you can save your map cycle configurations and load them later.

To save or load a map cycle, click on the "Save/Load Map Cycle' button while editing a map cycle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/4a7e21d3fae8859437be7b999da927154d041012.jpg[/img]
Type in the name of your map cycle in the "Map Cycle Name" box, and then press "save".
The map cycle you just named will now appear in the list of saved cycles. 💾

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/4d745a6dee0c1c4b1ee5dbff502f0a3c5712c2fe.jpg[/img]
You can load a previously saved cycle by clicking on it's name and pressing 'load'.
You can delete a previously saved cycle by clicking on it's name and pressing 'delete'. 🗑️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/9ec7959f9ba4da28d682334fd9fe14cd4e1e1df4.jpg[/img]
[h3]Additional Map Cycle Features[/h3]
[b]Randomizing Cycles[/b]
At the bottom of the map cycle preview, there is a 'random sequence' checkbox.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/1745ff0bc894018f307736dffe85b9c69cef478d.jpg[/img]
☐ If the box is unchecked: your chosen map cycle will play in a [b]linear sequence[/b], playing each map in order of selection before looping back to the beginning when all maps have been played.

☒ If the box is checked: your chosen map cycle will play in a [b]random sequence[/b], meaning any other map besides the one you are currently playing will be played in the following round.

[b]Duplicate Maps[/b]
You can select the same map multiple times when editing a custom map cycle.
This can be used to increase the chances of a specific map appearing in the random sequence, or to repeat specific maps after each round in the linear sequence.

For example, select each map twice so you and your friends can swap sides on the same map before cycling to a new map! 🔄

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/8a51de54733d2cb4dff017ac751ced995d2a3a53.jpg[/img]
[b]Editing Cycles during a Match[/b]
Map cycles can be edited mid-game by the host, in case you change your mind about the order or selection of maps. To do so, press the ESC key during a match and click "Next Match Settings" to open up the match settings and access the maps as you would when creating a custom match. Press "Save For Next Match" to apply your map cycle changes once the current round is complete. ✔️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/eef274af3b05baf2f963744c6119da27b926abd7.jpg[/img]
[h2]Achievement Improvements[/h2]
Achievements now pop-up on screen when you earn them! 🌟

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/171995c56333e9c1ec09d03126aabbd2a893430d.gif[/img]

You can now view your achievements and their progress in the "collection" screen on the main menu (just under the Prop Collection button)! 📜

⚠️ [b]Known Issue:[/b] Achievement dates are not displaying correctly - this will be fixed in an upcoming hotfix.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/bb5e435f0b521d9552e007aa0597e900f573fd49.png[/img]
[h2]Possess Balancing[/h2]
We've made some adjustments to the balancing of the witches' possess skill to keep it as an effective mobility option while ironing out some of the problems that made it far too overpowered.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/f154c106fb6ba503785fd28bff1d30bb152071e7.gif[/img]

[b]Mana Cost[/b]
To begin, our patch 1.4.0 changed the visual effects of the possess, significantly reducing the visibility of which direction the witch possessed towards. While we are enjoying this change so far, the time between possesses feels far too short, making escapes a lot less risky than before when combined with the new visual effects. ✨

As a result, we have increased the mana cost of possess from 40 to 50.

[b]Possessed Props[/b]
In our last major patch, we made a change that meant players left their original prop behind when possessing a new prop. Originally, this assisted witches in confusing the hunters during a pursuit, but now is very commonly used to scatter huge props - blocking doorways and disrupting the gameplay far more than we intended. ⛔

To fix this while keeping our original idea intact, props left behind by possess now dissolve after 5 seconds, unless they're repossessed. Please give the possess skill a try and let us know what you think!

[h2]Weathervanes[/h2]
Weathervanes now spin when hit by a projectile or touched! 💫

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/6887fc6e20f6ef2627c834163b6436c4f8633c6a.gif[/img]

Weathervanes can now only be uniformly scaled in Creative Mode to ensure they can spin when your map is being played. If you have any non-uniformly scaled weathervanes in your maps, they will be adjusted when loading the map to ensure their functionality. Weathervanes will not spin while your map is being edited in Creative Mode, but will function once you are playing your map in a custom match.

[h2]Patch Notes:[/h2]
Major Change:
All player stats and achievements are now coming from our own backend instead of Steam. This includes all player progress including levels, prop unlocks and so on. The values will be transferred upon first login. Please report any issues.

notes.title: Patch 1.4.0 - Modify your lobbies with Match Rules +!
notes.content:
[b]Welcome to Patch 1.4.0[/b], featuring [b]Match Rules +[/b], one of our biggest additions since 1.0! We're also excited to announce the [b]wardrobe[/b], a new utility that allows players to switch up their skills and sets mid-round. And as always, we've packed in a bunch of changes and additions - read on! 🎉

[img]https://i.imgur.com/MsZAMLT.gif[/img]

[h2]Match Rules +[/h2]
Introducing [b]Match Rules +[/b], a brand new way to modify your custom matches! Change a huge array of different parameters to design a unique match like no other. You can even save and load your favourite configurations for future use! ✨

To access Match Rules +, simply start a custom match through the main menu and select the "Match Rules +" option at the bottom of the screen. From there, you can adjust a range of variables across three tabs: General, Skills, and Game Modifiers. See below for a brief overview of each tab.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/7f9f3e4eb099cc704c949191830a5ba2bb4488c4.jpg[/img]

[h3]General Configurations[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/dda919ca646b47f7ca2377a9c11da012e693b3b5.jpg[/img]

On the first tab, you can change the fundamental parameters of your match, such as gravity, movement speed, jump height, player size, and more. 🔧

Move each slider according to your preferences, or enter a specific value in the boxes to the right of each slider. In case you wish to undo a change, click the ↺ button beside each parameter, or select the "reset all to default" button to revert all alterations you've made.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/RV4I5Um.gif[/img]
✔️ [i]Become a colossal Hunter using the player size multiplier![/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/TJqojWE.gif[/img]
✔️ [i]Lower the gravity and cause chaos![/i]

[h3]Skill Configurations[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/808fbbf837e5067d79ce770b94908b0ad43c574d.jpg[/img]

On the second tab, you can modify specific skill parameters, as well as the Hunter's melee and projectiles. Here, you can alter the damage, velocity, radius, mana cost and much more for each individual skill, as well as disable skills you don't want players in your match to use. 🥔

[img]https://i.imgur.com/JLUWzSc.gif[/img]
✔️ [i]Buff the mushroom split amount, but reduce the confusion time![/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/gkZLwS6.gif[/img]
✔️ [i]Increase the Hunter's projectile amount, speed and spread, but lower the damage![/i]

[h3]Game Modifiers[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/1b7f274444e5278403b4df8e593cdd3cc04fecc7.jpg[/img]

On the third tab, you can find our "game modifiers" - these are special modifiers that drastically change the gameplay of your match! Patch 1.4.0 comes with three game modifiers:

🔹 [b]Move It[/b]
All witches have to move to survive.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/YaMqeAS.gif[/img]

🔹 [b]Dissolving Props[/b]
Props will start disappearing over time.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/VXqzuUU.gif[/img]

🔹 [b]Prop Retaliation[/b]
Hitting non-Witch props will deal damage to Hunters.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/HTXFWNT.gif[/img]

To enable a game modifier, click on the corresponding modifier you wish to use and toggle the "Is enabled" parameter. Each modifier also has a few changeable parameters you can experiment with! 🧪

[h3]Save and Load Match Rules +[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/1e54e71b9012bbc6caf8b010e8791be3d47f6492.jpg[/img]

In the bottom right of the Match Rules + configuration, there is a button labelled "Save/Load Match Rules +". Once clicked, it will take you to a new screen where you can name and save your Match Rules + configuration. You can revisit this area anytime to overwrite your saved Match Rules +, or load a previous one you've created! 💾

[h3]Tweak Match Rules + During Custom Matches[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/2ce3a9974b729afd0c90cc8090726a83d60c10df.jpg[/img]

When starting a custom match, hosts can now find a new toggle on the page named "Tweakable Match Rules +". Enabling this toggle allows the host to modify parameters in real-time by accessing the in-game menu during a round and clicking the "Match Rules +" button, as shown below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/ec15c776f9c51ade51ed8ddf1ca4155c7e5b9378.jpg[/img]

For players wanting to try Match Rules +, we highly recommend enabling this option and experimenting with the different modifiers and parameters! Changes you make will take effect immediately, without requiring a server restart. So, feel free to get creative and see what kind of unique gameplay experiences you can come up with! 🧰

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Pp7a7TR.gif[/img]
✔️ [i]Tweak the rules while playing to find the perfect combination, then save your changes![/i]

[h2]Swap Skills & Sets Using The Wardrobe[/h2]
You can now swap your skills and custom sets during a match using the new 'wardrobe', found in the Hunter spawn of all Official and Featured Maps! A quick switch of your skill selection and appearance during play gives you the flexibility to adapt to any situation. And for our map creators: the wardrobe will be added to Creative Mode in a future update! 👖

[img]https://i.imgur.com/rVCGHcd.gif[/img]

[h2]Custom Match Search Time Capacity Increased[/h2]
The maximum search time in custom matches has been increased from 10 to 20 minutes, for those wanting to play extra long rounds with less pressure of running out of time! ⏰

[img]https://i.imgur.com/DyRo3kP.gif[/img]

[h2]Extinguishable Props[/h2]
Props that emit fire or smoke are now extinguished when they touch water! 🌊

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Cl08yoe.gif[/img]

In addition, we've added a temporary [b]Classic Prop Hunt[/b] mode on multiple servers to demonstrate the potential of Match Rules +. This mode features no skills for both teams and Hunters are damaged when they attack non-Witch props, but can scan props using melee as much as they want. Give it a try and let us know what you think! 🎮

We'd love to see what wild ideas you come up with Match Rules +, so please share your screenshots and videos with us over on our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/559650]Steam Hub[/url] or our [url=discord.gg/witchit]Discord server[/url]! 💜

notes.title: Patch 1.3.6 - Introducing 6 Faraway Lands Maps!
notes.content:
[b]Patch 1.3.6[/b] is here, and we're finally ready to reveal our [b]Faraway Lands | Official Map Contest 2022 winners[/b]... as well as introducing 7 new structures, skill effects, a long-awaited recipe, and more!

[h2]Faraway Lands Results![/h2]
[previewyoutube=tyle4DBbuCo;full][/previewyoutube]
A few months back, we ran our 3rd ever map creation contest, named [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/559650/view/3405310798878162022?l=english]"Faraway Lands"[/url]. Participants were tasked with creating a small-scale map suitable for 4-8 players, with just over a month to prepare their entries... ⌛

This time around, rather than providing a set visual theme, participants were able to let their creativity run wild and build as they like, as long as it was suitable for 4-8 players. With minimal reference to inspire this size of map, this was arguably our most difficult map contest yet. We discovered that each map creator had a vastly different approach to the player restriction; from the actual map size, to the prop density, or even utilising game mechanics like jump pads to help players traverse large sections. For clarification, the recommended player count for all winning Faraway Lands maps has been adjusted to 4-10 players in the map selection and voting screens - a little larger than we initially expected, but we hope this clears things up.

[b]Each winner will shortly receive a Witch It Steam key, 10x Crystallized Moonlight, their name added to the description of a Creative Mode structure (the new "metal wall"), and the fabled "Grand Architect" title within our community![/b]

We decided the winners based on a range of different factors, such as aesthetics and functionality, but map size was at the forefront of this choice. All maps were played with a lobby containing 8 judges (all from Barrel Roll Games), and our decision was made without bias towards any one creator or team. However, to prevent creators taking multiple winning spots in future contests, we are considering changing our rules for the near future. So if you didn't win this time around, don't feel disheartened - we'd love to have you back! 🎉

[b]All winning maps are now available to play in any Hide & Seek, Mobification, or Hunt a Hag Official server, or by pressing on the "Featured Maps" tab when setting up a custom match.[/b] ✔️

[h2]Our Winners![/h2]
[h3][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2894718880]🥇 Singing Sanctuary[/url][/h3]
Created by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/Farbenkeks/myworkshopfiles/?appid=559650]Farbenkeks[/url]
[i]“Ancient magic lingers in Singing Sanctuary and keeps the place evergreen.”[/i]

Following [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/559650/view/3123813625394321478?l=english]Precious Palaces[/url], Farbenkeks took home a well-deserved win with [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2726993045]Vermilion Valley[/url], cementing themselves in the community as one of it's most talented map builders. While Singing Sanctuary is thematically far different to their previous entry, Farbenkeks' close attention to detail and imaginative use of structures returns once again in its full glory. Congratulations!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/018979a62fc627d4aa862a18fd8ddd5f82c7cd83.jpg[/img]

[h3][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2892012890]🥇 Coven's Cove[/url][/h3]
Created by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198161108223/myworkshopfiles/?appid=559650]NotSure[/url] & [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/cdjs1987/myworkshopfiles/?appid=559650]CDJS[/url]
[i]“After a fateful run-in with a sea behemoth, The Coven of the Trade Winds washed ashore this tropical island. Shipwrecked and stranded, they've built a new life for themselves in the shelter of a small cove.”[/i] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2892012890][Full Story][/url]

Coven's Cove is CDJS and NotSure's debut entry to our map contests, and we're very impressed with what they've created! The landscape is relatively minimalist, yet greatly satisfying to traverse and hide within. Fans of Loakiki Paradise will find Coven's Cove familiar and comfortable to explore, but will need to be even more cunning with their hiding spots, since the cove is one of our smallest maps to date. Well done!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/93be7d03910571b6c331bf2f0fca41bc53da22e4.jpg[/img]

[h3][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2885247560]🥇 Bone Pit[/url][/h3]
Created by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/BasedReeks/myworkshopfiles/?appid=559650]Reekyu[/url]
[i]“A wooden fortress built on a fossil filled island.”[/i]

Reekyu never fails to miss a map contest, and subsequently never fails to miss out on a winning spot! Bone Pit is a masterpiece in both form and function; the map is visually stunning and extremely easy to navigate, with well placed pathways and jump pads. While on the larger-size compared to other winners, the jump pads allow Hunters to quickly travel across the map while scanning for hidden Witches. Great work, Reekyu!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/e8a59a17942a057cf929aab330872815af65f195.jpg[/img]

[h3][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2890398060]🥇 Ancient Temple[/url][/h3]
Created by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/BasedReeks/myworkshopfiles/?appid=559650]Reekyu[/url]
[i]“An ancient temple cursed with dark magic.”[/i]

Reekyu's second winning map of Faraway Lands is Ancient Temple, a dark and creepy interior-only map that's not for the weak-stomached. Look up, and you may see a spiders web so thickly-spun that even the temple's fallen stones haven't breached it's surface... amazing job!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/55822d2f7b5f232447e4f91ec429afe685092310.jpg[/img]

[h3][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2887651229]🥇 Martin’s Chamber[/url][/h3]
Created by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/YNVRL/myworkshopfiles/?appid=559650]Gelato[/url] & [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198831719002/myworkshopfiles/?appid=559650]Emote[/url]
[i]“Martin's Chamber aka "Odaia lui Martin””[/i]

Gelato and Emote, previous winners of Precious Palaces with [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2718664772]Kasbah le Ribat[/url], make a surprise return to Faraway Lands with Martin's Chamber! Enter an abandoned, overgrown mansion on an estate long-forgotten, and seek shelter within its ivy walls. Martin's Chamber makes clever use of structures to create a building that doesn't feel prefabricated... simply impressive!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/4d8bdf518d13e9c1ba18fe65e69fcdd1014a0b02.jpg[/img]

[h3][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2895793505]🥇 Sunset Swamp[/url][/h3]
Created by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/BasedReeks/myworkshopfiles/?appid=559650]Reekyu[/url]
[i]“Built on the edge of a swamp sits the home of a lonely, but happy hunter.”[/i]

Sunset Swamp is Reekyu's third and final winning map of Faraway Lands - we just couldn't shake the feeling that this one deserved to be among our winners too! A thick, dense swamp surrounds a hand-crafted settlement built from its surrounding resources. Take shelter indoors, or hide under the vines and shrubbery scattered across the swampland. Excellent work!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/14c731cfd1d8788e793840d59cf8374192784559.jpg[/img]

[h3]Honourable Mentions:[/h3]
As expected from our talented building community, all entries this contest were remarkable and consequently difficult to judge. Every entry we received deserved a win in their own unique ways. However, we wanted to showcase a few of our favourites that didn't make the final cut.
Please, subscribe to these maps below and send your support to these brilliant creators! 💌

Every author in the honourable mentions will receive a 10x Crystallized Moonlight bonus!
All entrants who weren't mentioned in this announcement will receive 5x Crystallized Moonlight, too!

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2892733405]Voodoo Village[/url] by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/friz0/myworkshopfiles/?appid=559650]fri.[/url] & [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/BasedReeks/myworkshopfiles/?appid=559650]Reekyu[/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2888233659]Fairground Island[/url] by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/mrHgbf/myworkshopfiles/?appid=559650]hgbf[/url] & [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198332743267/myworkshopfiles?appid=559650]Obscura[/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2896065453]Unknown Destination[/url] by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/mrHgbf/myworkshopfiles/?appid=559650]hgbf[/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2892114447]One Last Pint[/url] by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198161108223/myworkshopfiles/?appid=559650]NotSure[/url] & [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/cdjs1987/myworkshopfiles?appid=559650]CDJS[/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2892916990]Adelaide's Local Gallery[/url] by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198062122271/myworkshopfiles/?appid=559650]Milucha[/url] & [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198969080295/myworkshopfiles/?appid=559650]Salem[/url]
Don't forget to check out all the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2897952370]Faraway Lands entries here[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/983e77902cb60eb34504a8324221761effe2a890.jpg[/img]

[h2]Presentation Prize Results:[/h2]
This contest, we decided to introduce an all-new "Presentation Prize", awarded to the three entries with the best presented workshop pages. Since we had so many beautiful pages to choose from, we've decided to grant 4 winners for the presentation prize rather than our initial 3.

Each winner will receive 10 Crystallized Moonlight and their names added to the description of a Creative Mode structure (the "large wooden sign")! ✨

[h3][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2892916990]💎 Adelaide's Local Gallery[/url][/h3]

notes.title: Patch 1.3.5 - Year of the Rabbit & Valentines 2023!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/ac8e864d263746f74a89bf42cb1050e3981363be.png[/img]

[b]The Year of the Rabbit has begun![/b] It's time to celebrate with new skins, a player icon, 4 new action props, more switchables, a themed prop layout and more! 🐇

[h3](Another) Faraway Lands Update:[/h3]
Faraway Lands results are just around the corner - our next patch will introduce the winning maps to our Official map pool, and we can't wait to show you the results! Previously, we aimed to have this ready in January but we just need a little more time to carefully implement the new maps. Hang tight! ⌛

[h2]6 New CNY & Valentines Skins![/h2]
As always, we've got some incredible new Chinese New Years skins, including the Water Rabbit Hat and Hair for Witch, and the Water Rabbit Head for the Hunter. We hope you love them as much as we do!

And of course, Valentines is just around the corner - collect the Blooming Rose (projectile), Dreamy Cupid's Dart (melee, colour variant), and Scarlet Rose Bouquet (broom, colour variant) through crafting or the item cauldron. 💘

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/1f452aa28ae9cbc5a57c6d8479c00e1fa992e32d.jpg[/img]

[h3]How do I obtain the new Chinese New Year items?[/h3]
Opening Witch It during the Chinese New Year 2023 event will grant you 20 "Fireworks"!
A Firework contains a random Chinese New Years item (including CNY items from previous years), which can only be opened by combining them with "Gunpowder".

To earn Gunpowder, fill up the Item Cauldron with 250 experience points. You can see the item cauldron fill up at the end of the round, on the level up screen.

Gunpowder has a 40% chance of being earned on any Official server once the item cauldron is filled, and you can earn it on any map. If you're lucky enough to earn one, head back to the main menu and press 'Chinese New Years Event' to combine it with your Fireworks!

Every Chinese New Year 2023 item is tradable and craftable even after the event is over.
If you use up all your Fireworks, you can craft more by combining 5 Gunpowder together!
Note: Gunpowder can only be obtained in Official servers.

You can also receive the new items through:
- Random drops from filling up the item cauldron at the end of a round.
- Trading with other players (we recommend using our [url=discord.gg/witchit]Discord server[/url] to find traders).

[h2]Year of the Rabbit Player Icon![/h2]
Pair up your Rabbit-themed cosmetics with this limited-time "Year of the Rabbit" player icon!
Play at least one round of Witch it in an Official server during the Chinese New Year 2023 event to earn the icon, but be quick - after the event ends, it will no longer be obtainable! 🐰

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/9f2c0b778e0d46a5e2888a4d4222255ecc9f0f97.jpg[/img]

[h2]4 New Action Props & More Switchables![/h2]
Prop collectors - go find four new action props that each can be activated by pressing your "prop action" button ('E' by default). Introducing the Firecracker, Bomb, Confetti Cannon and Rabbit Firework - search for them in our Official maps! 🧨

In addition, all action props (that can be activated) are now switchable in Creative Mode, meaning you can now hook up fireworks, explosives, and much more to pressure pads and levers. We can't wait to see what interesting contraptions or scenic effects you come up with!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/948a96a4434ef4507979a6567ee0655f51dc7149.jpg[/img]

[h2]Pirate-Themed Twin Mask Theater Layout[/h2]
Arrrg! A new stage layout has sailed into Twin Mask Theater, loaded full of pirate-themed props for you to hunt and hide amongst. Call in your crewmates and go seek those pesky landlubbers! ☠️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/a81a6ee6f2e46989b0223dc7ffd6908e31f38eed.png[/img]

[h2]Patch Notes:[/h2]

notes.title: Patch 1.3.3 - Winterdream 2022!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/d735a3dda27db02933a3ae5c1ef3b87fece5014d.gif[/img]

[b]Happy Holidays![/b] We're super excited to reveal our Winterdream 2022 event: full of new skins, props, structures, layouts, ambient sounds, and more! And of course - by popular demand, the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/itemstore/559650]Winterdream shop has reopened for a limited time[/url]. 🎄

[h3]Faraway Lands Update:[/h3]
The Official Map Contest of 2022, Faraway Lands, is currently being judged by Barrel Roll Games and the community staff team. We expect to reveal the winners in January alongside a patch including all the winning maps in our Official server map pool. 🏆

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2897952370]Check out all the entries by clicking here![/url]

[h2]20+ New Winterdream Skins![/h2]
We've got plenty of new outfits ready for you to collect, including the Winterdream & Arcane Satyre sets, and the Temple & Mountain Yeti sets! Watch out for their horns...

Collect the limited-time "Winterdream 2022" icon by playing Witch It during the event - once Winterdream 2022 is over, the icon will never return! ⌛

Additionally, we've doubled the amount of skin sets that you can save and load between rounds!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/dbe962dc24568cc68b2acf78f1f415f010ab5604.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/e8af1f20f7ec51e07cce1df1ef63e78257ba7553.jpg[/img]

[b]Earning Winterdream 2022 Sets:[/b]
Open Witch It during the Winterdream 2022 event to earn 30 "Filled Boots". Combining 1 Filled Boot with 1 Cinnamon Star will craft 1 random Winterdream item (rare, very rare or whimsical).

To earn Cinnamon Stars, you must fill up the item cauldron with 250 experience points while playing one of our Winter maps: Snowbreeze or Fiskersted. The item cauldron fills up at the end of each round, during the level up screen. For every item cauldron opened on Snowbreeze or Fiskersted, there is a 40% chance that you'll receive 1 Cinnamon Star.

Crafting Winterdream items using Filled Boots and Cinnamon Stars grants a 50% chance of dropping a new Winterdream 2022 skin. You will receive the new sets more often than old sets!

Alternatively, you can earn these items through random drops during gameplay, or by crafting Winterdream item recipes in the Witches' Cauldron. You can also obtain these items through trading - we recommend using our trading channels in our [url=discord.gg/witchit]Discord server[/url]! 🤝

[h2]8 New Props![/h2]
Find our 8 new props amongst our Christmas prop layouts on Snowbreeze and Fiskersted, including a Winter Wreath, a Perfume Atomizer, and even a spectacular Grandfather Clock! Props you collect on Official servers can also be used in your Creative Mode maps - so go get collecting! 🕰️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/404b7a9ce8e112dc9829fea236b2a17e8c8acf24.jpg[/img]

[h2]10 New Roof Structures![/h2]
Mappers rejoice! We've added 10 new roof structures to Creative Mode to give you more options with your custom buildings. Piece segments together to create the perfect roof length, or discover a unique use for them by scaling and rotating them - either way, we hope you enjoy these new structures! 🧱

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/e0efc5e23137df38e059000650edd4188ea2831e.png[/img]

[h2]Map Voting Screen Changes[/h2]
We appreciate all your feedback regarding the split map voting pools for low and high populated servers! Generally, people felt this feature was too restrictive, so we've made some changes to the map voting screen to give players more power in their map choices. 🗳️

The voting screen now includes two big and two small maps for voting, as well as an option to vote for the previous map again. All maps now have a player recommendation in the bottom corner of their thumbnail.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/2997ef4ac83e60049c6df7588a66b21f5c2bae6c.png[/img]

[h2]Winterdream Game Rules[/h2]
In the server list, look out for our "Winterdream" servers - these servers have altered game rules, allowing all players to move faster with reduced skill cooldowns. In this mode, chickens have a far smaller radius but can be spammed more frequently, and we've also added an experimental "Train Hunter" skill that can travel through walls! 🚂

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/249232c940e2d3f507c3217491e0741cfe436df2.png[/img]

[h2]Prop Layouts and Ambient Sounds![/h2]
We've added a third prop layout to Flint Falls, Twisted House and Grave Gulch - which means every Official map now has at least three unique prop layouts.

Ambient sounds have now been added to some previous map contest winners, including Lost Temple, Oasis Temple, Niemeyer Legacy and Pizza Factory. Listen out for them! 🔊

[h2]Imposturous Additions![/h2]
Vote kick functionality has arrived to Imposturous, so if someone is being a nuisance in your lobby, you can cast a vote that will remove them from the match (hopefully you'll never have to use it!).

Also, keep your eyes peeled for a special community painting in the Imposturous map... 🖌️

[h2]Winterdream Shop![/h2]
The Winterdream Shop has returned for a limited-time! If you wish to support Barrel Roll Games by purchasing some of our Winterdream sets or the animated "BRG Supporter" icon, please [url=https://store.steampowered.com/itemstore/559650]click here[/url]! 🛒

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
The Winterdream Festival has begun! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/itemstore/559650]Also, the shop has reopened.[/url] It will be active until January 10, 2023.

+ Added: 20+ new Winterdream skin items
+ Added: 8 new props
+ Added: New temporary Winterdream servers with new game rules, a little faster movement with slightly different skills and an early version of the Train Hunter skill (WIP).
+ Added: 10 new roof structures to Creative Mode
+ Added: Third prop layout to ‘Flint Falls’, ‘Twisted House’ & ‘Grave Gulch’ (Every official map now has at least three unique prop layouts!)
+ Added: More ambient sounds to ‘Lost Temple’, ‘Oasis Temple’, ‘Niemeyer Legacy’ & ‘Pizza Factory’
+ Added: A community painting on the Imposturous map
+ Added: Vote kick functionality for Imposturous game mode

↻ Changed: Hunters can now pick up buffs while using the Power Ball skill
↻ Changed: Hunters in Creative Mode no longer get kicked if idle
↻ Changed: ‘Tome of Bravery’ now also has a toggleable light
↻ Changed: Doubled number of possible skin sets

notes.title: Faraway Lands | Official Map Contest 2022
notes.content:
⚠️ [b]Update: Entries are now closed, and the results will be revealed soon. Stay tuned![/b]

[i]Across the endless tomes secured within Grunewald Library, tales and rumours of faraway lands fill the pages…

Chronicles of small-scale hamlets, landscapes and monuments tell stories of the magnificent architects that built them.

Now it’s your turn to write the next chapter![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/e9001aff4f422317e3fd7b6d9801b344a2102278.png[/img]

🗺️ [b]Theme:[/b]
[b]Small Maps[/b] - You must build a map suitable for [b]4-8 players![/b]
Aside from the player capacity, there is no visual theme - get creative and build something unique!

🥇 [u][b]Main Prizes | Official Implementation:[/b][/u]

We will be implementing [b]multiple winning maps[/b] into our Official servers, which will be added to our voting pool when a server contains under 8 players. We have no particular number of winners in mind. Winning maps will also be available in custom matches.

All winning maps will receive baked lighting, and will be played for thousands of rounds to come!

[b]Each contributor in a winning map will also receive:[/b]
- 1x Witch It Steam Key (Giftable)!
- 10x Crystallized Moonlight!
- Your name added to the description of a Creative Mode structure!
- [url=discord.gg/witchit]Grand Architect Discord Role[/url]!

[b]Bonus:[/b] [url=discord.gg/witchit]All Discord entrants[/url] will receive the "Architect" role after posting their map entry. Entrants who have participated in previous map contests may receive "Architect (x2)" or "Architect (x3)". We’ll grant these roles towards the end of the contest.

🖼️ [u][b][NEW] Presentation Prize:[/b][/u]

This time, there are no community voting prizes. We are now offering a “Presentation Prize”, which is an additional reward granted to the three entries with the best presented workshop pages. To win this award, spend time making your workshop page visually appealing! You can add high quality screenshots, banners, a video (if you’d like), or anything else to make it stand out from the other entries. Feel free to add some lore or a backstory to your map too, but this won’t count towards the presentation prize!

[b]Each contributor towards a map which wins the presentation prize will receive:[/b]

- 10 Crystallized Moonlight!
- Your name added to the description of a Creative Mode structure!

✔️ [b]Participate in just 5 steps:[/b]

1. Create a custom Witch It map following our theme, rules and advice!

2. Upload your map to the Steam workshop!

3. Upload at least ONE screenshot onto your workshop page!

4. Add the hashtag [b]#mapcontest2022[/b] in the description - this helps us organise entries, as well as lets us know we can use your map on our servers!

5. Finally, post your entry in [url=discord.gg/witchit]#map-entries on discord.gg/witchit[/url] or underneath [b]this contest announcement[/b] on Steam!

📚 [i]Are you still unsure what to do?[/i] View our detailed participation guide here:
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2203730812
⚠️ [b][Important!] Rules:[/b]

> You must build on an empty map containing no structures (interior, town day, island day, town night, ice day, graveyard night, magical forest, desert day, desert sunset, or jungle day)!
> If you wish to build in a default map containing pre-made structures, such as Grave Gulch or Port Plunder, you must build out-of-bounds!
> You can submit as many maps as you want (however, quality is always better than quantity)!
> You can either make your map solo, or collaborate with up to 3 other creators - please mark them as a contributor to your workshop item!
> You cannot enter using other creator's maps that you are not an original contributor on (we will check for stolen work)!
> You must design an entirely original map - it cannot be based on an existing map from another game!
> You cannot edit your existing maps to be smaller - please make an entirely new map!
> Offensive/NSFW content is strictly prohibited!
> All users can enter, including Grand Architects (previous winners) and staff members!

⚠️ [b][Update] Switches:[/b] Switches are allowed in maps.

⚠️ [b][Update] Water:[/b] If you're building in out-of-bounds water, the physics of the water do not work properly and therefore will be unbalanced for gameplay. For this reason, please [b]avoid[/b] using out-of-bounds water in the playable areas of your maps.

🔨 [i]Breaking these rules may result in disqualification from the contest![/i]

📖 [b]Advice for Creating Entries for Faraway Lands:[/b]
Below is some advice for creating maps suitable for our Official servers. Please read each section carefully!

📕 [b]Size Matters[/b]
Your map must support 4-8 player lobbies! If your map is too small, Hunters will find it too easy to locate and eliminate Witches. If it’s too big, then Witches will have too many hiding options. Our hope is that you’ll create a map balanced somewhere in the middle. Be clever with how you tackle your map size - for example, start with a map segment, test it out, then expand. Or if you’re trying to fit more content in a narrow radius, consider extending your map vertically.

📙 [b]Test Your Map[/b]
One benefit from building smaller maps is that you don’t need as many players to do a suitable test. Round up a few of your friends (or even other entrants) and test each others maps thoroughly! A great looking map may be unapprovable if the gameplay mechanics are inconsistent or broken. Some things to watch out for include stairs that don't work, ladders that cannot be climbed, doorways that are too small etc. Hunters should have a spawn area that they cannot leave until the hiding period is over.

📒 [b]Optimise Your Maps[/b]
Ensure your map is smooth to run by optimising your structure and prop use - rather than using small wall segments, can you scale a single wall up to create the same effect? Have you removed objects in areas that aren't visible to the player during gameplay? Are there too many props?

Our recommendations:
[i]- Stay below 500 props
- Use any amount of structures
- Do not stack lights or jump pads
- Frozen props shouldn't glitch when touched[/i]

📗 [b]Broken Hiding Spots[/b]
Combining structures together can sometimes lead to small gaps in which props can fit into. This is most often seen with world boundaries, rocks, and ice structures - but can easily be avoided by vigorously checking intersections of structures. One small gap in a structure leading to a impossible-to-reach area for Hunters will result in a broken map. Please be mindful to ensure your maps have no broken hiding spots on them by testing during and after the creation of your map.

📘 [b]Gamemode Compatibility[/b]
Your map must be compatible with Hide & Seek, Mobification and Hunt a Hag. Please consider using a variety of props and gameplay options for both teams, and take into account the skills each team may use.

⌛ [b]Deadline[/b]
We are closing this contest on [b]Monday, 5th December, 2022 (12:00am UTC)[/b]
Once the contest ends, we will review your entries and decide on the winners, which will be revealed shortly after.

We hope you enjoy creating your maps! [i]#mapcontest2022[/i]

notes.title: Patch 1.3.1 - Happy Halloween!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/ebabf11e26afc02e60548732e639da2519fc53cf.gif[/img]

[b]Happy Halloween![/b] To celebrate the spine-chilling festivities, we're introducing our latest map: [b]Grave Gulch[/b], alongside new props, skins, structures, Creative maps and more! 👻

[h2]Before we begin... we want your feedback![/h2]
Our new [url=https://forms.gle/SqtqV8wBS1y9L4RTA][b]Witch It Feedback Survey 2022[/b][/url] is now live! Your answers will play an important part in the direction we take the game in the years to come. We are not collecting any personal data in this survey, and any answers provided will be kept anonymous if we decide to publish any results. Please click the banner below to participate in this survey:

[url=https://forms.gle/SqtqV8wBS1y9L4RTA][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/39207f55fa6c7bef6e1b28cf1fd4f11f4d327df7.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Grave Gulch[/h2]
[b]Welcome to Grave Gulch[/b] - a monstrous ravine cutting through a haunted valley, filled with critters, crevices and revolting cobwebs... 🎃

Hide among the harrowing foliage and abandoned buildings, or climb the rugged cliffs and possess a cocoon hanging far above the hunters below. Skilled witches will need to get creative with their escape routes, as the narrow play area leaves little room for error - climb a web or use a jump pad to make a quick get away!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/250d2a1b79d404b5669dbe70893ed4eb27842f53.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/2b98aabbdc3553a34a33f97e17837e12737636cb.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/9f12fbd9611e57597c41aec1b350ad17b428ad40.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/3c63204411243d6d667ee4b8c327edd56353a59b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/2754523882a5d08b7bf0f045df1780ce1ba94a56.png[/img]

[h2]14 New Props[/h2]
We've introduced a variety of Halloween and autumn-themed props, ready for you to add to your prop collection! Search Grave Gulch for the beehive, cocoons, and even a friendly mandrake! For those looking for a challenge: two new secret props are hidden within the gulch... good luck finding them! 🔎

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/5a98dad75573cf1fc6e7133f261910e19e329ff0.jpg[/img]

[h2]70+ New Structures[/h2]
As promised, we've introduced tons of Flint Falls structures to Creative Mode, polished and ready to be added into your custom maps. Included with the structures are new tiles, rock formations and even Grave Gulch's giant spider and webbing! 🕸️

Fancy participating in one of our [b]map contests[/b]? Keep an eye on our announcements on Steam and on our [url=discord.gg/witchit]Discord server[/url], as we'll be revealing our next contest on [strike][b]Friday, 21st October 2022[/b][/strike]! All skill levels are welcome, and yes... there will be prizes! 🏆

⚠️ [b]Contest Update:[/b] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/559650/view/3405310798878162022]Click here to view "Faraway Lands" - Official Map Contest 2022![/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/9630c47bcd6a319a20a3bc44a6720ab74e0bd7a6.jpg[/img]

[h2]40 New Skin Items[/h2]
Get dressed up for trick-or-treating with our new Halloween skins! Wrap yourself in old bandages and haunt Grave Gulch as a mummy, or decorate your witch as a spider and blend in with the insects living within the nooks and crannies. 🕷️

[h3]How do I obtain the new Halloween items?[/h3]
Opening Witch It during the Halloween 2022 event will grant you 30 "Gloomkins"!
A Gloomkin contains a [b]random Halloween item[/b] (including Halloween items from previous years), which can only be opened by combining them with "Haunted Candy".

To earn Haunted Candy, fill up the Item Cauldron with [b]250 experience points[/b]. You can see the item cauldron fill up at the end of the round, on the level up screen.

Filling up the cauldron on Sleeping Rose Cemetery, Cursed Ruins, Grunewald Library (Day) or Grave Gulch will grant you a [b]40% chance to receive a Haunted Candy[/b]. If you're lucky enough to earn one, head back to the main menu and press 'Halloween Event' to combine it with your Gloomkins! 🍬

Every Halloween 2022 item is tradable and craftable even after the event is over.
If you use up all your Gloomkins, you can craft more by combining 5 Candies together! 
[i]Note: Candies can only be obtained in Official servers.[/i]

[b]You can also receive the new items by:[/b]
- Crafting Halloween recipes in the Witches' Cauldron (main menu > collection > Witches' Cauldron).
- As random drops by filling up the item cauldron at the end of a round.
- Trading with other players (we recommend using our [url=discord.gg/witchit]Discord server[/url] to find traders).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/9a5608a52e5cc6ec33415257647b67aa015a11a6.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/2ba6ebdf33d003e2dcc21ed26ec3dfe0c05f3a47.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/ab6411cef3293334a5b738b17ab0dfef8619f130.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Creative Maps[/h2]
We've introduced [b]3 new Creative Maps[/b] which you can use as a base for your epic maps and prop layouts. Flint Falls has been added - time to build your own prehistoric maps! "Jungle Day" is a flattened Flint Falls for those who want to build their own custom terrain. Grave Gulch is also available for those wanting to build maps in a spooky environment - we hope you enjoy them as much as we do! 🦇

Haven't tried our Creative Mode yet? Press "play" in the main menu, then "creative mode" to start your own Creative server with your chosen parameters. From there, you can build your own environments to hunt and hide in. Need some inspiration? Check our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/browse/?appid=559650&browsesort=trend&section=readytouseitems&actualsort=trend&p=1&days=-1]most popular workshop maps here[/url]!

notes.title: Patch 1.3.0 - Dawn of the Potato!
notes.content:
[b]Welcome to Dawn of the Potato[/b], an era in which the first ever hunters built their potato-slinging legacy. Flint Falls is where it all began: a primitive encampment located at the foot of an enormous waterfall, containing both resources and witches plentiful... :purplewitchhat:

[previewyoutube=LY9MxIcLUOk;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]Fan-made teaser created by [url=http://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198083575700]fri.[/url] Subscribe to his [url=https://www.youtube.com/c/Friz0]YouTube channel[/url] for more spectacular Witch It content![/i]

[h2]Flint Falls[/h2]
Flint Falls is a primeval-themed map located in the clearing of a prehistoric jungle. A stunning waterfall towers over the map, connecting to a fast-flowing river that may pull you along if you're not careful. Thick stone slabs on the surface mark the beginning of a civilisation, but also double up as great hiding spots for the witches - but for those who want some proper shelter, locate the cave system underground and see what you can find! :hunterface:

Flint Falls is more compact than most of our Official maps, encouraging faster-paced gameplay on highly populated servers, or a more balanced experience for the smaller gaming posse.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/3485b8108ad2ab8cb9a71fb9c453582ebc6c9250.jpg[/img]

[h2]Quest Drops & 18 New Skin Items[/h2]
Collect a pair of pants made from a leopard pelt, or maybe a broom made from the bone of a humongous dinosaur!

Want to obtain the new skin items? After completing or rerolling your current daily quests, new quests will have a [b]high chance to reward Dawn Of The Potato items[/b]! :luaq:

[i]The DOTP items are not part of an event or a collection, and therefore can be crafted through standard recipes or obtained as normal drops.[/i]

notes.title: Patch 1.2.7 - 5 Year Anniversary!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/647b23b10d445d03a86e1f1dfd975888416c9d63.gif[/img]

[h2]We appreciate you![/h2]
5 years ago today, we cautiously pushed the Early Access release button... anxious, yet hyped for the world to play our wacky little game.

Positive reactions to our Alpha and Beta testing periods gave us a spark of confidence we desperately needed to hit that button, no matter how daunting the following journey may be. Since releasing a game was a first for the team, we didn't set our ambitions too high - our only goal: to bring as much joy to our players as to us making the game. 💜

Within a matter of months, we were absolutely blown away by the abundance of support for Witch It!

To describe ourselves as fortunate would be an understatement; there's simply no words that can articulate how grateful and proud we are to have turned our passion project into a full-time career. And as cliché as it sounds... we [b]really[/b] couldn't have done it without you. Whether you joined us in the Alpha, Beta, Early Access, after the full release, during a sale, during an event or after watching your favourite creator, we deeply appreciate you being here and supporting us all these years.

And we're not just saying that...

5 years is a [b]long[/b] time, especially when working on content non-stop. Any rational person would probably tell us we need a break. However, remember that spark we felt right before we pressed that release button? It never left us.

So we're not going anywhere. In fact, [b]we're doubling down.[/b]
We've taken substantial steps over the past year to multiply the size of our development team, so we can continue working on Witch It for the years to come! We strongly believe our best years are still ahead of us. So whether you're a new player or a seasoned veteran, we hope you stick with us!

Thank you for everything. We owe it all to you! ːluaqː

[i]~ Barrel Roll Games[/i]

[h2]A Nostalgic Timeline[/h2]
Let's take a trip to the past. Below is a timeline of all the major news that followed the release of Witch It Early Access on May 31st, 2017. It's so fascinating to see how far the game has evolved over the past 5 years! At which part of the timeline did you join us? 📅

[img]https://i.imgur.com/9cyFcoK.jpg[/img]

[h2]5th Anniversary Hats[/h2]
Every celebration needs a cake. Pick up the "5th Anniversary Cake Hat" for the Witch, and the "5th Anniversary Witch Hat" for the Hunter by playing at least one round in an Official server! 🎂

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/9513578579778320ce9e63cf41975680ab78107f.jpg[/img]

[h2]5th Anniversary Player Icon[/h2]
Is it really a Witch It event if there's no player icon? 🐔🥚
Of course not! And since it's such a special occasion, we've made it animated too!
Open up the game and play at least one round in an Official server to obtain it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/7816656bee5915e8eefdb9af7d67a052aa87ecff.jpg[/img]

[h2]Anniversary Servers[/h2]
We've released a fresh batch of 'anniversary' servers which you can now find on the server list. In these servers, we've altered the game rules so that every skill is more powerful than before! The gameplay is a lot more manic and unpredictable, but extremely fun! Please let us know what you think, as we may make some changes and additions to these servers over the next few weeks. We also plan to give players the ability to use these game rules in custom servers soon!

We've also enabled [b]double rewards for quests[/b] during the Anniversary event - however, these will only apply to newly generated quests. Complete or skip your current quests to see the double rewards in action! 🎁

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/d1c4e11d8ecf0e5c4441f699c679478c310708d9.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch 1.2.6 - Spring Fever!
notes.content:
[b]Spring Fever is here![/b] Patch 1.2.6 introduces new skins, a themed player icon, new props (and layouts), as well as switchable doors for Creative mode. Read on to learn more! :rollingbarrel:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/9b29b846d0fbcbf8b6fc2b7b798c918c00cf1b50.jpg[/img]

[h2]Spring Fever 2022[/h2]
Opening Witch It during the Spring Fever 2022 event will grant you [b]10 "Spring Baskets"![/b]
A Spring Basket contains a random Spring Fever item (rare or above), which can only be opened if you earn a [b]"Colorful Egg"[/b].
To earn a Colorful Egg, fill up the Item Cauldron with [b]250 experience points[/b]. You can see the progress during the level up screen at the end of the round.
For every Item Cauldron you open, there is a [b]20% chance[/b] that you'll receive 1 Colorful Egg!

Every Spring Fever item is tradable and craftable even after the event is over.
If you use up all your baskets, you can craft a new basket by combining 5 Colorful Eggs together! 🥚
[i]Note: Colorful Eggs can only be obtained in Official servers.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/95aa991cd991fc6ff4e587af9dc4dc58949ab267.jpg[/img]

[h2]Snow Bunny Set[/h2]
Alongside our popular bunny outfits, we're excited to introduce the new "snow bunny" set! Snow bunny is rare rarity, part of the 'Spring Fever' event item pool, and can be obtained through the limited-time event (opening spring baskets), crafting (witches' cauldron), or as a normal drop (a small chance after filling up the item cauldron at the end of a round). 🐰

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/cc1481791bee7e96e76f0d51921993a416de0c95.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Achievement & Sandwi(t)ch Hat[/h2]
Achievement collectors! We invite you to attempt our latest challenge - collecting 50 secret props hidden in our maps. Find 50, and you'll unlock our delicious new "Sandwi(t)ch Hat" for your Witch! 🥪
[i]Note: Achievement progress is limited to Official servers.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/9dc394b8254226259aa773a9f727c43d5108b12b.png[/img]

[h2]Spring Fever 2022 Player Icon[/h2]
Receive the "Spring Fever 2022" icon by playing a round of Witch It during our Spring Fever event!
This icon is only obtainable for a [b]limited time[/b], so don't miss out! 🐣

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/17e07031983789adc6677180cc89a2699c3db330.jpg[/img]

[h2]10+ new props and new prop layouts[/h2]
Spring-themed props are here, including a water can, an Easter wreath, paper windmills and much more! Alongside our new props are new prop layouts for 'Twisted House', 'Shard of Wiqqarra', 'Amara's Fountain', 'Cursed Ruins' and ‘Port Plunder’ - get hiding! 👀

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/69da4e774d057e1ff8a46868ab589592540365f9.jpg[/img]

[h2]Switchable Doors[/h2]
Switchable doors block both witches and hunters if closed by a switch. If opened, these act like completely normal doors. Use this to lock-off secret rooms, invent new obstacles, or add some mechanical depth to your awesome maps. That reminds me - we've now reached over [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/browse/?appid=559650&browsesort=trend&section=readytouseitems&actualsort=trend&p=1&days=-1]1000+ Steam workshop submissions[/url], so you'll never be short of a new experience or landscape to hide within! 🗺️

[b]Note[/b] - in Creative mode, switchable doors visually stay open to indicate they can be walked through during a match, or closed if they cannot be walked through currently.

[b]Note:[/b] The switchable palace door cannot be lowered if a prop is blocking its underside.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/be47822cfc7976ddbef8f0c44cf88779e27d86e4.gif[/img]

[h2]Featured Maps & Light Baking[/h2]

You'll now find "Featured Maps" in the map selection menu, which includes all the contest winner maps. Additionally, all remaining "Featured Maps" have baked lighting now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/dbaa32271eb9472bf70c463250f77942821a777b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/764cb7e77df01478ce52ff97a4cd5afb393ec337.gif[/img]

[h2]Full Patch Notes[/h2]

notes.title: Patch 1.2.5 - Including 6 Precious Palaces Maps!
notes.content:
[b]Patch 1.2.5[/b] has arrived, featuring 6 new player-created maps added to the Official map pool, our new Portal 2 item, and a handful of magnificent additions to Creative Mode (including two new switch variations). Read on! ːluaqː

[h2]Precious Palaces Maps[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/71577d3c97f7f05e644f65d97d65b7672fcdadfb.jpg[/img]

[i]The Djinn's twin brother is finally satisfied. The world met his cries with countless palaces to pick from. Without rest, the Djinn's twin brother scooped up the keys to his 6 favourite palaces and ran off into the sunset without delay...[/i]

Following the result of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/559650/view/3117056324361568168]community vote[/url], we spent a few weeks deciding on the maps we felt fit best into the wonderful world of Witch It. Today, we reveal the [b]6 winning maps that you can play right now[/b] in any Hide & Seek, Mobification, or Hunt a Hag server!

All entrants, winners or not, will receive the bonus [b]"Pyramid Hat"[/b] reward shortly!
The Pyramid Hat has also been added to the Mystic Sands item pool within the very rare rarity.
In addition, all entrants who have not won during community voting or the main prize will receive 3 additional Crystallized Moonlight! Thank you to all our entrants for their incredible efforts. ːrollingbarrelː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/a1a8eff8779d3f8f0e6dfecc6483ebd91ac993aa.jpg[/img]

Each winner is now considered a [b]Grand Architect[/b], and will each be granted a Witch It Steam key, 10x Crystallized Moonlight, their name added to the description of the new "Precious Palaces Winners Trophy" Creative Mode structure, and the Pyramid Hat bonus reward. Check out the winners below, in no particular order:

[h3]🥇 [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2720104554]Lost Temple[/url][/h3]
Created by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198259766042/myworkshopfiles/?appid=559650]ShadZ[/url]
[i]"Thousands of years ago, the Temple of Aetes was once a magnificent and resplendent temple in the middle of the desert. The temple was surrounded by plentiful water and fertile land, which they owe to the magic of Aetes and crystals. However, this magic disappeared from time to time. Increasingly frequent sandstorms destroyed the temple in all possible parts. After a while, the temple sank into the ground and disappeared. Only a small oasis remains. A Rumor says that the spirit of Aetes still lurks within the halls of the temple."[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/5e5119531caad1b7752d27ebd995fca04143b743.png[/img]

[h3]🥇 [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2334048996]Oasis Temple[/url][/h3]
Created by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198353165324/myworkshopfiles/?appid=559650]Candybober[/url]
[i]"Filled with palms and water, the magical Oasis Temple was discovered by our great Lord. Our Lord is interested in the witches' magic crystals; he believes they can be harnessed to control the world! We wish to steal as many crystals as we can from the temple to repurpose it in our own technology. However, the witches are upset and have returned to the temple to enact their revenge. Catch these pesky witches, and we will reward you with countless riches beyond your imagination!"[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/c0060c9d31783df0b40c26d588cc1ffdeae1284f.png[/img]

[h3]🥇 [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2726993045]Vermilion Valley[/url][/h3]
Created by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/Farbenkeks/myworkshopfiles/?appid=559650]Farbenkeks[/url] & [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/RealCubey/myworkshopfiles/?appid=559650]David / Cubey[/url]
[i]At the end of the endless desert where the golden horizon turns red, the Vermilion Valley streches to the darkness of forgotten shadows. Legend has it that somewhere in the valley lies a powerful source of magic. In no other place did the Djinn build a palace to meet many guests and to pass the time with games.

The reputation of the wonderful new palace finally reached his brother who could not hide his envy: "No one will ever have a more beautiful palace than me!" he shouted and sent out his army.

Festivities in the Vermilion Valley go on as usual when suddenly at sunrise ominous riders appear on the horizon. Pale and frightened the Djinn whispers, "We must try to wake the dragons."[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/9dcb17105a9ec04de2adeaccde477e23d1b136f8.png[/img]

[h3]🥇 [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2725319566]Palace of Heka[/url][/h3]
Created by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/BasedReeks/myworkshopfiles/?appid=559650]Reekyu[/url]
[i]"A magical palace with many stories told! Deep in the Amara desert resides the Palace of Heka, a residence so expansive that even the Djinn is envious... Nimble Hunters and Witches alike can vault across the various walkways and rooftops to reach different rooms within the layered structure of the building. For those wanting a quicker option, various jump-pads can be utilised to swiftly reach the inner regions of the palace from the outer passages and vice versa."[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/dfdc3fdd3dff5faf8ba41f22ec8967bf4f59f4ad.png[/img]

[h3]🥇 [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2722954905]Citadel of the Sun Keeper[/url][/h3]
Created by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/algiac/myworkshopfiles/?appid=559650]algiac[/url]
[i]"The ancient Citadel of the Sun Keeper lies secluded in an unknown location in the middle of the desert. It was built by a mighty Djinn who assigned the construction to a grand architect of his time with an unspeakable name. The magnificent palace is faced towards east, so during sunset the sunlight suffuses the splendid throne hall and shines through the whole building. Underneath the throne hall you will find a cozy lounge with armchairs, pillows and carpets, but the ground floor also holds the grave chambers of the Djinn's ancestors. His unbelievable wealth is undoubted as the whole palace is ornated with shining blue crystals, although the origin of them remains a mystery. Some say they contain incredible magic powers and thus ensured the authority of the Djinn."[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/a40d611ead648a2f123e4d471959f130ed4d7574.png[/img]

[h3]🥇 [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2718664772]Kasbah le Ribat[/url][/h3]
Created by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/YNVRL/myworkshopfiles/?appid=559650]Gelato[/url], Assisted by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198831719002/myworkshopfiles/?appid=559650]Emote[/url]
[i]"Word spread far and wide across the land of the djinn's new palace. Many people had come to visit it and see for themselves. It was both lavish and ornate. Everyone that saw it showered the djinn with compliments. The djinn's brother, however, was not to be outdone. Hearing of his brother's success, he was overwhelmed with jealousy, and decided to do something about it. "The witches in the Morgaryll Forest might be willing to help me, if I pay them handsomely with moonlight shards.", he said to himself. And so he traveled by land and sea to the great and distant Morgaryll Forest to seek the aid of its witches. Trespassers had better have good reason to seek them out or be prepared to face dire consequences."[/i] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2718664772][Full Story Here][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/071ad48e52f20b4b54029453662f680aee3f0cc5.png[/img]

[h3]Honourable Mentions[/h3]
The talent levels showcased during Precious Palaces were next level! Judging was extremely tough and we struggled to settle on our final 6. That being said, here's a few of our favourites that weren't showcased during community voting. Please check them out! ːpurplewitchhatː

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2685493842]Sanctum[/url] by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/BasedReeks/myworkshopfiles/?appid=559650]Reekyu[/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2712240388]Ruined Palace[/url] by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198353165324/myworkshopfiles/?appid=559650]Candybober[/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2673642911]Djinn Delta[/url] by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/BasedReeks/myworkshopfiles/?appid=559650]Reekyu[/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2712149740]Sessoya's Palace[/url] by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198332743267/myworkshopfiles/?appid=559650]Obscura[/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2695396164]Desert Paradise[/url] by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/mrHgbf/myworkshopfiles/?appid=559650&sort=score&browsefilter=myfiles&view=imagewall]hgbf[/url]
Don't forget to check out all [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2729416165&snr=2_9_100013_]Precious Palaces Entries here[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/5a5388783b1703dbfa2f36bdcba1ccc16a741c97.jpg[/img]

[h2]PotatOS Projectile (Portal 2)[/h2]
Your favourite omnipotent potato companion has arrived... [b]PotatOS[/b] is now instantly available for all owners of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/620/Portal_2/]Portal 2[/url] on Steam! To obtain it, open Witch It and play at least one round on any Official server. ːpotatothrowː🧡

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/65ba93bd98bc356b7e2d1fe459d4fe2444a2f5f1.jpg[/img]

[h2]Switch Variations + Single-Use Switches[/h2]
For those wanting to spice up their mapping skills, we've added two new switch variations! The [b]pressure pad[/b] will be active as long as someone is stood on the pad. The [b]lever[/b] switch functions the same to the original stone switch. Toggling the "[b]Break After Use[/b]" option will cause them to stop functioning after being activated once. We can't wait to see what wacky contraptions and mechanics you create with this new option!

Find the new switches by accessing the 'utilities' tab in the Creative Mode menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/7d12a0bf524944852cfd0bf558031f4f0f0a24dc.png[/img]

[h2]Filtering Switchable Props[/h2]
As our assortment of switches grows bigger, we felt it was only right to add a handy new filter for all switchable props. Open up the menu while in Creative Mode and press the checkbox to the right of the search bar to show only props with features that can be toggled on/off!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/4accffadf9cb3e3583089d95c714aa8e05f86920.gif[/img]

[h2]Full Patch Notes[/h2]

notes.title: Mystic Sands - Short Video Contest!
notes.content:
[h2]Are you feeling creative?[/h2]

Mystic Sands is here, packed full with all-new props, locations, and clothing items - a filmmaker's dream!

This contest, we're looking for [b]short video entries[/b], rather than GIFs. You can now upload videos with sound to make your stories and creations that much more interesting!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/921d40a2596f18050f9ebde138bda0c2cd2be059.jpg[/img]

In our previous contest, pumpkin22/7, CandyBober and Gelato won the "Fruit Parade" with their incredible entries. Here are our previous winners: 

pumpkin22/7 - "From Hunter To H(a)unted"
https://imgur.com/a/mtJJ2Bj

CandyBober - "This is what I call a real artist"
http://imgur.com/gallery/Ttu3zWm

Gelato - "Fruit Festival"
https://imgur.com/a/hnIVZpK

🌟 [b]The Prizes:[/b]
We're looking for three talented creators to impress us with their short videos...
Each winner will receive a GIF Masters Hat, and 5 Cryptic Artifacts!
Cryptic Artifacts can be used in obtaining our brand-new Mystic Sands event items.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/0a412069968b678628210cef9fbe3f97bb973c8e.jpg[/img]

🌴 [b]Theme:[/b]
The theme is [b]Mystic Sands[/b] - your short video [b]must[/b] be located in [b]Shard of Wiqqarra[/b] or [b]Amara's Fountain[/b]!

🧙‍♀️ [b]How do I participate?[/b]
Post your entries below this announcement or in our #mystic-entries channel over on [url=discord.gg/witchit]discord.gg/witchit[/url]!

📜 [b]Rules [Important!][/b]
Videos must be between [b]1 and 30[/b] seconds. Longer entries [b]will not count![/b]
You can edit your videos with text, images and other media - [i]copyrighted media will be deleted![/i]
Your friends can help you record and edit if necessary - but [b]only[/b] the person uploading is eligible for the prize!
Entry filetypes can be [b]MP4[/b] or a [b]YouTube Link[/b]. [b]GIF[/b] is permitted if you upload using Imgur!
Winners of the Fruit Parade [b]are not eligible[/b] for prizes this contest to allow for others to win. Winners of earlier GIF contests [b]can[/b] enter but can only compete for [b]one[/b] of three hats.
Community staff can enter but [b]cannot vote[/b] on their own work.
Offensive/rude content is [b]prohibited[/b]. Rules still apply to competition entries!
[b]Twitch Clip Links[/b] are permitted, but [b]only[/b] if you're the streamer featured in the clip!
Your videos can include gameplay, or be completely animated in another software - as long as it [b]distinctively relates to Witch It[/b] and primarily features at least one of the new maps!
You are limited to [b]ONE ENTRY[/b] - make it your best work! You may delete, replace or edit your entries as much as you want during the contest period. Entries edited after the deadline will become [b]void[/b]!

[b]Important Tip: Toggle your in-game UI while recording by pressing ALT-J![/b]
[i](In most cases, we highly recommend this as this may improve your chances to win)[/i]

[b]Entries Open: 6th November 2021[/b]
[b]Entries Close: 20th November 2021 @ 11:59pm (UTC)[/b]
Use https://dateful.com/time-zone-converter to convert the deadline to your local time!

[b]Winners will be judged by Barrel Roll Games and the Community Team![/b]
[i]Enjoy yourselves![/i]

notes.title: Official Map Contest 2020
notes.content:
[h1]We're (almost) ready![/h1]

[h3]Greetings![/h3]

You’ve heard it countless times before, but we [b]really[/b] mean it when we say Witch It 1.0 is just around the corner - and with that, our biggest, most tremendous content update yet!

We’ve jam-packed our 1.0 update with plenty of surprises. Today, we reveal one of those surprises - [b]custom maps are soon arriving onto Official servers![/b]

Barrel Roll Games are eager to implement a selection of beautifully crafted, well-functioning maps that will appear as a separate voting option between rounds… [i]but we need your help![/i]

Your task is to create a unique custom map that can be used across all gamemodes (excluding Fill a Pot), that is both visually stunning and practical for standard 16-player gameplay.
If you win, your map may be host to countless matches and play a core part in the player’s Witch It experience!

[h3]🏆 Prize Information:[/h3]

If you win, your map will be added to our Official server map pool during our 1.0 release!

We are allowing for multiple winners - there is currently no capacity on how many entrants can win!

In addition, all entrants who submit their map on discord.gg/witchit will receive the brand new Architect role, while competition winners will receive the mighty Grand Architect role!

The winners will be chosen by community staff as well as Barrel Roll Games who will have the final decision. Community staff cannot vote for their own creations. You can vote for your favourite maps over on our Discord server in the #contest-submit channel, but all entries will be considered regardless of votes!

[h3]🔨 Participate in just 5 steps:[/h3]

[b]1.[/b] Create a custom [b]Witch It map[/b] following our rules and advice below!

[b]2.[/b] Upload your map to the [b]Steam workshop![/b]

[b]3.[/b] Upload [b]at least ONE screenshot[/b] onto your workshop page!

[b]4.[/b] Add the hashtag [b]#mapcontest2020[/b] in the description - this helps us sort entries as well as lets us know we can use your map on our servers!

[b]5.[/b] Finally, post your entry [b]under this announcement[/b], or in the [b]#contest-submit channel[/b] over on discord.gg/witchit - we'll be watching both throughout the contest!

If you get stuck, or need some more information on the participation process, here’s a step-by-step guide:
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2203730812

[h3]⚠️ [Important!] Rules:[/h3]

> You must build on an empty map with no structures (interior, town day, island day, town night, ice day, or graveyard night)!
> You can submit as many maps as you want (remember, quality over quantity)!
> You can either make your map solo, or collaborate with up to 4 creators - please mark them as a contributor to your workshop item!
> You can enter with previously-made maps - just follow steps 2 to 5!
> You cannot enter using other workshopper’s maps that you are not an original contributor on (we will check for stolen work)!
> You must design an entirely original map - it cannot be based on an existing map from another game!
> Offensive/NSFW content is strictly prohibited!
> All users can enter, including GIF Masters and community staff!

[i]Breaking these rules may result in disqualification from the contest![/i]

[h3]📜 Advice to maximise your winning chances:[/h3]

> Avoid glitches - such as physical prop chains or impossible to reach hiding spots!
> Your map should work with Hide & Seek, Mobification, and Hunt a Hag.
> Make sure to extensively test your maps before submitting!
> Aim to use an optimised amount of props - we recommend below 1000!
> You can use as many structures as you want!
> Make sure your map supports a 16-player lobby - consider the size of your map!

[h3]⌛ Deadline:[/h3]

We aim to close the contest on [b]Sunday, 13th September 2020.[/b]
After that, we will be reviewing your entries and deciding on the winners, which may be revealed shortly after.

We wish the best of luck to all prospering Architects!

notes.title: Patch 0.9.5.2
notes.content:
This Patch is mainly a maintenance Patch and the preparation to the version 1.0.
Witch It is finally coming out of Early Access soon, yay!
The main focus of this Patch is the update of the Unreal Engine from 4.23 to 4.25.1
In this update, we dropped the unofficial 32 Bit Windows support. From now on Witch It will only run on 64 Bit versions of Windows as it will be technically very difficult to still support 32 Bit and over 99% of the users have a 64 Bit Windows anyway.
If you find any unexpected behavior of the game please let us know on Steam or Discord.

Added: There is a new Background on Grunewald Library

Changed: completely overhauled the system how health and speed are generated for props. Before it was created manually, and now it is calculated per prop size. Balancing should be generally the same, but please let us know what you think about it.
Changed: Prop Collection UI is now more in line with the other menus

Fixed: it is no longer possible to get out of map on Shipwreck Hollow and Kula Kula Islands
Fixed: lowered the speed of the cucumber on chummy potato
Fixed: all menus except creative mode should now work with controller
Fixed: high player level numbers now fit inside of their panel
Fixed: Showing player level 1 instead of the correct player level will happen less likely

notes.title: Patch 0.9.0
notes.content:
The Halloween Event has begun! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZZXCGJy.gif[/img]

-Added: New game mode “Fill a Pot” 

The new game mode is an objective mode where the Witches have to fill 3 of the 5 cauldrons to win the round, while the Hunters must prevent them from doing so.
Join a game of “Fill a Pot” and choose your team. You will get sorted randomly into the Witch team or the Hunter team. Currently, you can play 2vs2. (We’re already testing 1vs1 and 3vs3). For this game mode the Possess skill is deactivated and the Garlic and Mushroom skills have shorter effects (Garlic 6 instead of 10 seconds, Mushroom 2 instead of 4 seconds). If your team member leaves the game, you are able to surrender and still get the XP. Your selected skills for this game mode are saved separately.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/xz9CS7V.gif[/img]


-Added: Video tutorial for the new game mode
-Added: 35+ new Skin Items for the Halloween Event

-Changed: A peculiar moon appeared on ‘Grunewald Library’ and will stay there until the end of the Halloween Event
-Changed: Hunter AFK timeout changed from 45 sec. to 60 sec.


-Fixed: There was a bug which prevented Witches from using transform after trying to transform when standing in the Garlic zone.
-Fixed: Mushrooms don’t cause infinite confusion on the Hunter anymore.

notes.title: Patch 0.8.5
notes.content:
We completely removed Magic Dust and replaced it with Power Ups for both teams.
To compensate, we increased playtime xp from 20 to 30 per minute.
Win xp multiplier got reduced from 50% to 25%.
Overall you will receive around the same xp as before.
To replace the Magic Dust we added Power Ups to the game.
So far, there are 2 Witch Power Ups and 2 Hunter Power Ups.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/hUFSXrB.gif[/img]


Witch:
Heal:
-Heals for 50% of max health
-When this brings you over 100%, it generates overheal
-Overheal has an reduced rate, so you get only 25% of max health as overheal
-Overheal is capped at 50% so you can only get up to 150% of original health

Mana Boost:
-Increases your mana regeneration rate immensely for 20 sec.
-To prevent Power Ups from making the skills too overpowered, we added small 1.5 sec cooldowns to existing Witch spells and rebalanced mana costs

Hunter:
Speed Boost:
-Increases the movement speed by 40% for 45 sec.

Rapid Fire:
-Removes stamina and increases fire rate for holding fire for 20 sec.


-Added 9 new player icons for you to collect.

-Changed: Optimized shadow rendering. Shadows should now cost less CPU and less GPU, which should make the game faster on older PCs. On lowest shadows settings dynamic shadows are now completely removed. The look a bit less good on highest settings.
-Changed: It is now possible to activate the jump pad with Potatoes again.
Changed: Mana regen rate is now also applied while Spells are in use. Mana per sec costs of all spells got increased to compensate that.
-Changed: Reduced speed of the Half Bread
-Changed the maximum search time for custom matches from 8:20 min to 10 min.

-Fixed: Some op spots on Shipwreck Hollow & Port Plunder
-Fixed: Gap in the world border on Loakiki Paradise (sneaky Ice Pops)
-Fixed: ‘Odd Potion’ transform under the map issue
-Fixed: Spectators can use teleporters again
-Fixed: Spring Pad will be triggered by potatoes again
-Fixed: Candles are now in the correct state when possessed or transformed into
-Fixed: The outer candles of the Candle Stand now flicker also.
-Fixed: Props with lights are now always in the correct state when switching between first and third person view as server
